arXiv:2608.04001v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 8 月 4 日arXiv:2608.04001v1 [cs.LG] 04 Aug 2026

推理法学硕士中的测试时间缩放：推理机制、评估和再现性Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility

Mohsen Hariri   Weicong Chen   Nahal Shahini   Vikash Singh   Kai Ye
Amirhossein Samandar   Debargha Ganguly   Sreehari Sankar   Yanyan Zhang
Shouren Wang   Jerry Peng   Biyao Zhang   Michael Hinczewski   Vipin Chaudhary
{mohsen.hariri,weicong,nxs814,vikash,kxy406,axs2935,debargha,sxs2284,yxz3106,sxw992,jxp1146,bxz297,
mxh605,vipin}@case.edu
Case Western Reserve University
摘要Abstract

当允许大型语言模型在推理时花费更多计算时，它们可以解决更困难的推理问题。 术语Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems when they are allowed to spend more compute at inference time. The term测试时间缩放test-time scaling然而，现在指的是一组不同的推理算法，包括沿着单一轨迹扩展审议的方法、对已完成的候选样本进行采样并通过投票或验证来聚合它们以及搜索未完成的部分状态的方法。这些算法在统计结构、计算核算和故障模式方面有所不同。在单一标量“预算”下将这些程序视为可互换的，或者在没有生成推理协议的情况下报告准确性，使得研究结果难以进行比较。 我们开发了沿三个轴的测试时间缩放的系统说明。首先，我们将测试时间缩放形式化为自回归模型的隐式前缀树上的预算推理，并区分三种结构机制：单轨迹顺序缩放、具有终端缩减的叶级缩放和前缀级缩放。其次，我们将评估对象视为整个推理系统，并制定将端到端系统性能与候选库诊断分开的评估原则。我们引入了一种评估配置文件，其坐标和简单函数恢复或绑定常见的重复采样指标，并规定了计算和不确定性的协议匹配报告。第三，我们指定推理协议的再现性要求，区分精确重放和分布式再现性，并确定支持每种再现性所需的工件。我们还通过模型端和接口机制组织开放权重推理生态系统，将这些原则应用于广博知识、符号推理和竞争数学基准，并组装, however, now refers to a diverse set of inference algorithms, including methods that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, and search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar “budget,” or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over22十亿条完整推理轨迹，通过逐渐丰富的验证器和令牌级信号进行发布。billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.111API列表见附录For the API list, see AppendixF;发布数据见附件; for the release data, see AppendixG.

https://mohsenhariri.github.io/scorio/tts    https://huggingface.co/datasets/harimo/scorio

1 简介Introduction

当允许大型语言模型 (LLM) 外部化中间推理步骤并在推理时消耗额外的计算时，大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常会在困难的推理任务上变得更有能力。早期关于思维链提示和自我一致性的工作表明，当模型生成多步骤解决方案并聚合多个样本时，算术、符号和常识推理可以显着提高Large language models (LLMs) often become substantially more capable on difficult reasoning tasks when they are allowed to externalize intermediate reasoning steps and consume additional computation at inference time. Early work on chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency showed that arithmetic, symbolic, and commonsense reasoning can improve markedly when models generate multi-step solutions and aggregate multiple samples(Wei et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2022)。最近的系统将故意推理视为明确的设计目标，而不是提示工件：DeepSeek-R1 使用强化学习来引发长形式推理. More recent systems treat deliberate reasoning as an explicit design target rather than a prompting artifact: DeepSeek-R1 uses reinforcement learning to elicit long-form reasoning(Guo et al., 2025); Phi-4 推理将策划的监督痕迹与基于结果的强化学习相结合; Phi-4-reasoning combines curated supervised traces with outcome-based reinforcement learning(Abdin et al., 2025); Qwen3 暴露了明确的“思考”模式和推理预算控制; Qwen3 exposes explicit “thinking” modes and reasoning-budget controls(Team, 2025); gpt-oss 版本提供了经过大规模蒸馏和强化学习训练的开放权重推理模型; and the gpt-oss release provides open-weight reasoning models trained with large-scale distillation and reinforcement learning(OpenAI, 2025)。因此，推理性能现在不仅取决于训练前和训练后，还取决于测试时计算的分配方式。. As a result, reasoning performance is now shaped not only by pretraining and post-training, but also by how computation is allocated at test time.

尽管取得了这些进展，但这句话Despite this progress, the phrase测试时间缩放test-time scaling用于描述几种本质上不同的推理算法。一些方法沿着单一的演化轨迹分配额外的计算，例如，通过强制更长时间的审议或自适应地干预一个响应is used to describe several materially different inference algorithms. Some methods allocate extra compute along a single evolving trajectory, for instance, by forcing longer deliberation or adaptively intervening on one response(Muennighoff et al., 2025)。其他人对多个已完成的候选者进行采样，并使用投票、重新排名、基于验证者的选择或最小贝叶斯风险解码来减少它们. Others sample multiple completed candidates and reduce them using voting, reranking, verifier-based selection, or minimum-Bayes-risk decoding(Wang et al., 2022; Cobbe et al., 2021; Freitag et al., 2022)。还有一些搜索未完成的部分状态，如思想树、RAP 和值引导解码. Still others search over unfinished partial states, as in Tree-of-Thoughts, RAP, and value-guided decoding(Yao et al., 2023; Hao et al., 2023; Yu et al., 2024)。这些机制的不同之处在于统计结构、候选者的诱导提案分布、计算会计和故障模式。在单一标量“预算”下将它们视为可互换的会掩盖正在评估的实际程序，并使跨论文比较难以解释. These regimes differ in their statistical structure, induced proposal distributions over candidates, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating them as interchangeable under a single scalar “budget” obscures the actual procedure being evaluated and makes cross-paper comparisons difficult to interpret(Welleck et al., 2024; Snell et al., 2025).

相应地，评估比单独对基本模型进行基准测试更加微妙。在实践中，测量的性能取决于完整的推理协议：提示模板、解码器、搜索控制器、减速器、验证器或判断器、停止规则和数值设置。最好的-Evaluation is correspondingly more subtle than benchmarking a base model in isolation. In practice, measured performance depends on the full inference protocol: the prompt template, decoder, search controller, reducer, verifier or judge, stopping rule, and numerical settings. Best-of-NN验证者引导的重新排名可以提高准确性，但随着候选集的增长，不完美的代理分数本身可能会被过度优化and verifier-guided reranking can improve accuracy, but imperfect proxy scores may themselves be overoptimized as the candidate set grows(Gao et al., 2023; Huang et al., 2025; Khalaf et al., 2025)。 LLM 法官对开放式输出提供灵活的评估，但之前的工作记录了诸如位置和冗长效应等偏见，最近的工作表明，法官质量在测试时间缩放设置中高度依赖于任务和程序. LLM judges provide flexible evaluation of open-ended outputs, yet prior work documents biases such as position and verbosity effects, and recent work shows that judge quality is highly task- and procedure-dependent in test-time scaling settings(Zheng et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2025)。即使提示和方法是固定的，基准估计也可能因随机解码和实现细节、激励区间估计和显式再现性控制而变化. Even when prompts and methods are fixed, benchmark estimates can vary due to stochastic decoding and implementation details, motivating interval estimates and explicit reproducibility controls(Miller, 2024; Blackwell et al., 2024; Ye et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025b)。因此，对测试时间缩放下的推理进行严格研究需要精确的算法词汇、与部署的推理算法相匹配的评估协议，以及明确模型端训练选择和推理时间控制的模型比较。. A rigorous study of reasoning under test-time scaling thus requires a precise algorithmic vocabulary, evaluation protocols matched to deployed inference algorithms, and model comparisons that are explicit about both model-side training choices and inference-time controls.

开放权重推理生态系统的速度和异质性放大了对明确系统级评估的需求。最新版本涵盖强化学习优先推理模型This need for explicit system-level evaluation is amplified by the pace and heterogeneity of the open-weight reasoning ecosystem. Recent releases span reinforcement-learning-first reasoning models(Guo et al., 2025)、以数据为中心、以验证为中心的 SFT 管道, data-centric and verification-focused SFT pipelines(Ye et al., 2025; Guha et al., 2025)，围绕已发布的跟踪语料库和训练代码构建的开放复制品, open reproductions built around released trace corpora and training code(Hugging Face, 2025a; Open-R1 Team, 2025b)，以及在单个检查点或参数空间中结合推理和非推理行为的混合系统, and hybrid systems that combine reasoning and non-reasoning behavior either within a single checkpoint or in parameter space(Team, 2025; Yang et al., 2025)。这种多样性具有科学价值，但也使得比较容易混淆：两个检查点的监督信号、推理风格、计算预算和聚合协议可能同时不同。因此，该领域受益于将这些轴分开并将推理评估为完整推理系统的属性而不是单独的模型权重的研究。. This diversity is scientifically valuable, but it also makes comparisons prone to confounding: two checkpoints may differ simultaneously in their supervision signals, reasoning styles, compute budgets, and aggregation protocols. The field, therefore, benefits from studies that separate these axes and evaluate reasoning as a property of the full inference system rather than of model weights alone.Figure˜1将这种转变总结为选择性的时间顺序：推理时间算法、模型端训练和界面控制共同演化为性能取决于检查点、界面、控制器或减速器、评估器、停止规则和预算的系统。summarizes this shift as a selective chronology: inference-time algorithms, model-side training, and interface controls have co-evolved toward systems whose performance depends on the checkpoint, interface, controller or reducer, evaluator, stopping rule, and budget.

本文解决了这一差距。我们将测试时间缩放形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的一系列预算推理算法。我们对采样推理的处理将每个轨迹计算的证据与完整池的决策分开；因果停止是单独建模的，因为它会改变发电成本。然后，共享库比较可以隔离聚合，而端到端评估则可以衡量完整的推理系统。候选库质量是通过结构化诊断来报告的，包括用于在发现和稳定性之间进行权衡的统一的重复采样指标系列。我们在一系列广泛的当代开放权重推理模型上实例化这些想法，并组装起来This paper addresses that gap. We formalize test-time scaling as a family of budgeted inference algorithms over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model. Our treatment of sampled inference separates the evidence computed for each trace from decisions on a completed pool; causal stopping is modeled separately because it changes generation cost. Shared-bank comparisons can then isolate aggregation, whereas end-to-end evaluation measures the complete inference system. Candidate-bank quality is reported through structured diagnostics, including a unified family of repeated-sampling metrics for the trade-off between discovery and stability. We instantiate these ideas on a broad set of contemporary open-weight reasoning models and assemble over22百万推理轨迹，支持轨迹分析、验证者培训以及跨科学、推理和竞赛数学的可重复研究。million reasoning traces to support trace analysis, verifier training, and reproducible study across science, reasoning, and competition mathematics.

我们的主要贡献如下：Our main contributions are as follows:

  • •

    正式化测试时间缩放。Formalizing test-time scaling.我们将测试时间缩放的统一形式化为隐式前缀树上的预算推理，并区分三种结构机制：单轨迹顺序缩放、叶级缩放和前缀级缩放。We present a unified formalization of test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling, and prefix-level scaling.

  • •

    建立测试时间缩放的评估原则。Establishing evaluation principles for test-time scaling.我们评估整个推理系统：基本模型、提示、解码器、推理时间证据、搜索或聚合规则、停止控制器、评估器和预算。由此产生的原则将共享库聚合比较与端到端性能以及事后选择与因果停止分开。他们还需要相关轴的计算报告以及实际协议的不确定性估计。We evaluate the entire inference system: base model, prompting, decoder, inference-time evidence, search or aggregation rule, stopping controller, evaluator, and budget. The resulting principles separate shared-bank aggregation comparisons from end-to-end performance and post-hoc selection from causal stopping. They also require compute reporting on the relevant axes and uncertainty estimates for the actual protocol.

  • •

    提供开放推理生态系统的以模型为中心的视图。Providing a model-centric view of the open reasoning ecosystem.我们通过模型端和接口机制（包括经过验证的 SFT 和蒸馏、强化学习或偏好优化、推理时间控制和参数空间融合）来组织和比较代表性的开放权重推理模型，以便比较基于最直接影响推理质量、可控性和成本的机制。We organize and compare representative open-weight reasoning models by model-side and interface mechanisms—including verified SFT and distillation, reinforcement learning or preference optimization, inference-time control, and parameter-space fusion—so that comparisons are grounded in the mechanisms that most directly affect reasoning quality, controllability, and cost.

  • •

    释放大规模推理追踪资源。Releasing a large-scale reasoning-trace resource.我们发布了超过We release a corpus of over22跨越科学、推理和竞赛数学的数百万个推理轨迹序列，旨在作为分析推理行为、培训或校准评估者以及提高推理模型研究的可重复性的可重用资源。million reasoning-trace sequences spanning science, reasoning, and competition mathematics, intended as a reusable resource for analyzing reasoning behavior, training or calibrating evaluators, and improving reproducibility in reasoning-model research.

2 形式化测试时间缩放Formalizing Test-Time Scaling

测试时间缩放最自然地被视为一系列Test-time scaling is most naturally viewed as a family of预算推理算法budgeted inference algorithms建立在固定的自回归模型之上。最近的工作研究通过终端缩减、自适应单轨迹审议以及部分推理状态搜索来重复采样，作为使用固定基础模型花费额外推理时间计算的不同方式built atop a fixed autoregressive model. Recent work studies repeated sampling with terminal reduction, adaptive single-trajectory deliberation, and search over partial reasoning states as distinct ways of spending additional inference-time computation with a fixed base model(Welleck et al., 2024; Snell et al., 2025; Muennighoff et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2024)。这些方法背后的共同对象是由生成引起的隐式前缀树：额外的计算可能会沿着单个轨迹、跨多个已完成的叶子或在完成之前的内部前缀上花费。我们将这一观点形式化，并用它来区分三种结构体系。. The common object behind these methods is the implicit prefix tree induced by generation: extra compute may be spent along a single trajectory, across multiple completed leaves, or over internal prefixes before completion. We formalize that view and use it to distinguish three structural regimes.

The term缩放scaling指性能如何随预算变化；这并不意味着每种方法的性能都必须是单调的。refers to how performance varies with budget; it does not imply that performance must be monotone for every method.

我们使用以下操作分类法，如图所示We use the following operational taxonomy, illustrated inFigure˜2.

单轨迹顺序缩放。Single-trajectory sequential scaling.

每一步最多有一个未完成的活动前缀。额外的计算会改变该前缀的扩展、修改或终止方式，但永远不会分支到竞争前沿。At every step, there is at most one unfinished active prefix. Additional computation changes how that prefix is extended, revised, or terminated, but never branches into a competing frontier.

叶级缩放。Leaf-level scaling.

额外的计算会产生一批已完成的候选者。候选轨迹之间的任何交互都会通过终端减速器推迟到候选轨迹完成后。Additional compute produces a bank of completed candidates. Any interaction between candidate trajectories is deferred until after the candidates have completed, via a terminal reducer.

前缀级缩放。Prefix-level scaling.

根据未完成前缀的分数分配额外的计算。扩展、修剪、部署分配或终止决策取决于完成前的部分状态。Additional compute is allocated based on scores for unfinished prefixes. Expansion, pruning, rollout allocation, or termination decisions depend on partial states before completion.

这些机制在系统级别并不相互排斥：许多实用方法都是混合的，最常见的是前缀搜索，然后是叶级缩减器。These regimes are not mutually exclusive at the system level: many practical methods are hybrids, most commonly prefix search followed by a leaf-level reducer.

单轨迹方法维持一种活动状态A single-trajectory method maintains one active stateztz_{t}以及剩余预算and remaining budgetbtb_{t}。在步骤. At steptt，控制器选择元动作, a controller chooses a meta-action

典型的行动包括继续生成、抑制Typical actions include continuing generation, suppressing埃欧斯eos、附加控制字符串或批评、更改解码超参数或停止。预算强制方法，例如, appending a control string or critique, changing decoding hyperparameters, or stopping. Budget-forcing methods such ass1是该模板的直接实例，并且当更一般的推理时间元生成程序保持单个演化响应而不是分支边界时，也适合它are direct instances of this template, and more general inference-time meta-generation procedures also fit it when they keep a single evolving response rather than a branching frontier(Muennighoff et al., 2025; Welleck et al., 2024).

这种机制的结构优势是编排开销低：所有额外的计算都致力于单个不断发展的候选者。它的结构局限性在于，由于不存在竞争的未完成前缀，从早期的误解中恢复需要沿着相同的路径进行明确的自我修正，而不是寻找替代方案。The structural advantage of this regime is low orchestration overhead: all extra compute is devoted to a single evolving candidate. Its structural limitation is that, because no competing unfinished prefix exists, recovery from an early misconception requires explicit self-revision along the same path rather than searching for alternatives.

2.3.2 故障模式和预算分配Failure modes and budget allocation

叶级缩放的主要优点是增加计算量可以增加候选覆盖范围，而不会带来早期修剪的风险。其故障模式来自于减速机。不完整的验证者可能会承认误报：The main advantage of leaf-level scaling is that increasing compute increases candidate coverage without risking early pruning. Its failure modes come from the reducer. An incomplete verifier can admit false positives asNN增长，而错误指定的学习分数可能会通过硬 argmax 选择而过度优化，从而产生非单调的 Best-of-grows, while misspecified learned scores can be overoptimized by hard argmax selection, producing the non-monotone Best-of-NN最近关于奖励模型过度优化和推理时间奖励黑客的工作中记录的行为behavior documented in recent work on reward-model overoptimization and inference-time reward hacking(Gao et al., 2023; Huang et al., 2025; Khalaf et al., 2025)。基于判断的减速器还继承了协议敏感性，例如位置偏差和冗长偏差，因此判断设计和提示是评估方法的一部分. Judge-based reducers also inherit protocol sensitivities such as position bias and verbosity bias, so judge design and prompting are part of the method under evaluation(Zheng et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2025)。最后，叶子计数和评估器计数是不同的预算：MBR 式减速器可能需要. Finally, leaf count and evaluator count are distinct budgets: MBR-style reducers may requireO​(N2)O(N^{2})实用程序调用，激励近似实现，例如基于置信度的修剪和更快的 MBR 近似utility calls, motivating approximate implementations such as confidence-based pruning and faster MBR approximations(Cheng & Vlachos, 2023; Jinnai & Ariu, 2024).

因此，固定样本计数只是叶级设计选择之一。人们可以选择A fixed sample count is therefore only one leaf-level design choice. One may instead chooseN=N​(x)N=N(x)通过解决by solving

N​(x)∈arg⁡maxn:Cgen​(n)+Ceval​(n)≤B⁡𝔼​[Ux​(y^n​(x))],N(x)\in\arg\max_{n:\,C_{\mathrm{gen}}(n)+C_{\mathrm{eval}}(n)\leq B}\mathbb{E}\bigl[U_{x}(\hat{y}_{n}(x))\bigr],

哪里whereCgenC_{\mathrm{gen}}表示发电成本，denotes generation cost andCevalC_{\mathrm{eval}}涵盖推理时间评分、控制和缩减。最近的推理扩展研究明确优化了这种预算分配，并表明难度自适应计算可以主导固定计算covers inference-time scoring, control, and reduction. Recent inference-scaling studies explicitly optimize this budget allocation and show that difficulty-adaptive compute can dominate fixed-NN基线baselines(Wu et al., 2024; Snell et al., 2025).

2.4 前缀级缩放：搜索部分状态Prefix-level scaling: search over partial states

前缀级缩放在轨迹完成之前分配计算。为了涵盖标记级搜索和步骤级方法，例如 Tree-of-Thoughts、RAP 和类似 AlphaZero 的解码，令Prefix-level scaling allocates compute before trajectories are complete. To cover both token-level search and step-level methods such as Tree-of-Thoughts, RAP, and AlphaZero-like decoding, letzz表示一种搜索状态，表示由一个或多个推理步骤组成的文字标记前缀或宏前缀，并写denote a search state representing either a literal token prefix or a macro-prefix composed of one or more reasoning steps, and writeSucc​(z)\mathrm{Succ}(z)其允许的扩展for its allowed expansions(Yao et al., 2023; Hao et al., 2023; Wan et al., 2024b).

前缀级方法维护活跃边界A prefix-level method maintains an active frontierℱt\mathcal{F}_{t}，一组已完成的叶子, a bank of completed leaves𝒴t\mathcal{Y}_{t}，以及剩余预算, and remaining budgetbtb_{t}。通用迭代是. A generic iteration is

预算可以计算生成的代币、节点扩展、推出调用、验证者或判断调用、或挂钟成本。与叶级缩放不同，未来的计算分配明确取决于对未完成状态的评估。The budget may count generated tokens, node expansions, rollout calls, verifier or judge calls, or wall-clock cost. Unlike in leaf-level scaling, future compute allocation depends explicitly on evaluations of unfinished states.

Most practical methods ignore this coupling and use one-leaf surrogates such as correctness probability, process reward, or rollout return.

当学习值估计不可靠时，可以通过蒙特卡罗补全来估计连续值：When learned value estimates are unreliable, continuation value can be estimated by Monte Carlo completion:

Q^MC(z)=1Mroll∑m=1MrollUx(Y(m)),Y(m)∼qρ(⋅∣x,z).\widehat{Q}_{\mathrm{MC}}(z)=\frac{1}{M_{\mathrm{roll}}}\sum_{m=1}^{M_{\mathrm{roll}}}U_{x}\!\left(Y^{(m)}\right),\qquad Y^{(m)}\sim q_{\rho}(\cdot\mid x,z).

MCTS 式的推理方法可以解释为结构化的部署分配以及这些估计的备份MCTS-style reasoning methods can be interpreted as structured rollout allocation together with backup of these estimates(Hao et al., 2023; Wan et al., 2024b).

健全的部分检查。Sound partial checks.

部分检查A partial checkH​(x,z)∈{0,1}H(x,z)\in\{0,1\} is 拒绝的声音sound for rejection if

H​(x,z)=0⟹Ux​(y)=0for all ​y⪰z.H(x,z)=0\;\Longrightarrow\;U_{x}(y)=0\quad\text{for all }y\succeq z.

只有健全的前缀测试才能证明安全修剪的合理性。学习价值或奖励模型通常不提供这种保证。Only sound prefix tests justify safe pruning. Learned value or reward models generally do not provide this guarantee.

2.4.4 分数引发的搜索程序Score-induced search procedures

光束搜索。Beam search.

集束搜索保持尺寸前沿Beam search keeps a frontier of sizeKK并更新它and updates it by

ℱt+1=TopK​(⋃z∈ℱtSucc​(z);S​(⋅)).\mathcal{F}_{t+1}=\mathrm{TopK}\Bigl(\bigcup_{z\in\mathcal{F}_{t}}\mathrm{Succ}(z)\,;\,S(\cdot)\Bigr).

标准波束搜索用途Standard beam search usesS=SLLS=S_{\mathrm{LL}}，而验证者引导和价值引导的变体用学习的前缀分数替换或增强可能性, while verifier-guided and value-guided variants replace or augment likelihood with learned prefix scores(Yu et al., 2024; Lightman et al., 2023).

最佳优先搜索。Best-first search.

最佳优先搜索重复扩展得分最高的活动前缀，Best-first search repeatedly expands the highest-scoring active prefix,

z⋆∈arg⁡maxz∈ℱt⁡S​(z),ℱt+1=(ℱt∖{z⋆})∪Succ​(z⋆).z^{\star}\in\arg\max_{z\in\mathcal{F}_{t}}S(z),\qquad\mathcal{F}_{t+1}=(\mathcal{F}_{t}\setminus\{z^{\star}\})\cup\mathrm{Succ}(z^{\star}).

在经典搜索中，可接受的启发式方法可以产生最优性保证；在 LLM 推理中，学习到的前缀分数通常是启发式的，而不是可接受的In classical search, admissible heuristics can yield optimality guarantees; in LLM reasoning, learned prefix scores are generally heuristic rather than admissible(Koh et al., 2025).

MCTS 式搜索。MCTS-style search.

蒙特卡罗树搜索交替选择、扩展、评估和备份。标准 UCT 规则选择Monte Carlo tree search alternates selection, expansion, evaluation, and backup. A standard UCT rule selects

at∈arg⁡maxa⁡(Q​(z,a)+cuct​log⁡n​(z)n​(z,a)),a_{t}\in\arg\max_{a}\left(Q(z,a)+c_{\mathrm{uct}}\sqrt{\frac{\log n(z)}{n(z,a)}}\right),

哪里wheren​(z)n(z)和andn​(z,a)n(z,a)是访问计数，并且首先选择未访问的操作。 PUCT 等策略先验变体用先验行动调节的奖励取代了纯粹的 UCT 奖励。在 LLM 推理、RAP、类似 AlphaZero 的搜索和相关方法中，使用基于 rollout 或学习的值估计来实例化此模板are visit counts and unvisited actions are selected first. Policy-prior variants such as PUCT replace the pure UCT bonus with one modulated by an action prior. In LLM reasoning, RAP, AlphaZero-like search, and related methods instantiate this template with rollout-based or learned value estimates(Kocsis & Szepesvári, 2006; Browne et al., 2012; Hao et al., 2023; Wan et al., 2024b)。思想树可以被视为在思想级别而不是令牌级别扩展上运行的相关搜索控制器. Tree-of-Thoughts can be viewed as a related search controller operating over thought-level rather than token-level expansions(Yao et al., 2023).

其他控制器变体，包括学习的搜索策略和奖励引导的目标，在附录中讨论Additional controller variants, including learned search policies and reward-guided objectives, are discussed in AppendixC.

2.4.5 缩放行为以及与叶级方法的比较Scaling behavior and comparison to leaf-level methods

当前缀分数将预算集中在高价值分支上时，前缀级搜索的计算效率会明显提高。它的额外困难是由前缀分数驱动的修剪决策改变了对可达完成的支持。如果正确叶子的每个祖先都被修剪，则后面的计算无法恢复该叶子。因此，相关的统计特性通常不是全局校准，而是在竞争前沿状态上引起的实例内排序。Prefix-level search can be markedly more computationally efficient when prefix scores concentrate budget on high-value branches. Its additional difficulty is that pruning decisions driven by prefix scores change the support of reachable completions. If every ancestor of a correct leaf is pruned, no later computation can recover that leaf. Consequently, the relevant statistical property is often not global calibration but the within-instance ordering induced over competing frontier states.

在固定预算下Under a fixed budgetBB，前缀搜索也会在完整的叶子上诱导其自己的有效提议分布，, prefix search also induces its own effective proposal distribution over completed leaves,

qsearch,B​(y∣x)=Pr⁡(y^B​(x)=y),q_{\mathrm{search},B}(y\mid x)=\Pr\bigl(\hat{y}_{B}(x)=y\bigr),

这共同取决于记分员、控制员和停止规则；当搜索返回银行而不是单个叶子时，相应的对象是返回银行的每叶子包含概率。因此，前缀搜索返回的候选银行不是独立同分布的。借鉴自which depends jointly on the scorer, controller, and stopping rule; when the search returns a bank rather than a single leaf, the corresponding object is the per-leaf inclusion probability of the returned bank. Candidate banks returned by prefix search are therefore not i.i.d. draws fromqπ(⋅∣x)q_{\pi}(\cdot\mid x)，因此直接与叶级 Best-of- 进行比较, so direct comparisons to leaf-level Best-of-NN必须标准化生成成本和评估成本。must normalize both generation cost and evaluator cost.

最后，前缀搜索创建具有共享前缀的大型分支结构。高效的树结构推理内核通过键值缓存重用来利用这种共享，这可以极大地改变实际的计算前沿； DEFT 是一个代表性的例子Finally, prefix search creates large branching structures with shared prefixes. Efficient tree-structured inference kernels exploit this sharing through key-value cache reuse, which can materially change the practical compute frontier; DEFT is a representative example(Yao et al., 2025)。因此，许多实际系统是混合的：前缀搜索首先构建搜索引发的完整叶子库，然后叶级缩减器选择最终输出。稍后用于总结此类候选银行的重复抽样指标在. Many real systems are therefore hybrid: prefix search first constructs a search-induced bank of completed leaves, and a leaf-level reducer then selects the final output. The repeated-sampling metrics used later to summarize such candidate banks are introduced inSection˜3.4.

3 评估测试时间缩放Evaluating Test-Time Scaling

在测试时间缩放下，报告的性能取决于Under test-time scaling, reported performance depends on the完整推理协议full inference protocol在前缀树上定义defined over the prefix tree inSection˜2.1。该协议决定了. The protocol determines both the候选人分布candidate distribution以及最终的输出规则。其规范包括预算分配、解码或搜索、推理时间证据、聚合和停止规则以及任何验证者或判断者调用。因此，评估应说明基准结构、诱导的and the final output rule. Its specification includes budget allocation, decoding or search, inference-time evidence, aggregation and stopping rules, and any verifier or judge calls. Evaluation should therefore state the benchmark structure, the induced提案分发proposal distribution，聚合和停止协议，报告的, the aggregation and stopping protocol, the reported估计值estimand，以及不确定性过程。, and the uncertainty procedure.

3.1 作为评估结构的基准设计Benchmark design as evaluation structure

基准设计确定测量哪种能力以及额外的推理时间计算是否可以有意义地改变结果。因此，在测试时间扩展下，基准测试套件应由Benchmark design determines which capability is measured and whether additional inference-time compute can meaningfully change outcomes. Under test-time scaling, benchmark suites should therefore be organized by评价结构evaluation structure，不仅通过任务领域或历史流行度。, not only by task domain or historical popularity.

主要区别在于A primary distinction is between可验证的verifiable和and开放式的open-ended任务。在数学和代码生成等可验证的设置中，可以精确地或通过执行来检查正确性，因此重复采样和终端缩减目标是相对尖锐的正确性标准tasks. In verifiable settings such as mathematics and code generation, correctness can be checked exactly or by execution, so repeated sampling and terminal reduction target a comparatively sharp correctness criterion(Chen et al., 2021; Li et al., 2022)。在开放式环境中，评估依赖于评分标准、成对偏好或判断模型；因此，评估协议本身（包括提示、比较顺序、侧面随机化和聚合）是正在评估的方法的一部分. In open-ended settings, evaluation relies on rubrics, pairwise preferences, or judge models; consequently, the evaluation protocol itself—including prompts, comparison order, side randomization, and aggregation—is part of the method being evaluated(Liang et al., 2023; Zheng et al., 2023; Chiang et al., 2024)。在具有社会影响的任务中，评估目标从任务效用延伸到公平性，使用预测性能和群体公平性指标评估数据水平、训练时间和后处理缓解策略. In socially consequential tasks, the evaluation target extends beyond task utility to fairness, with data-level, training-time, and post-processing mitigation strategies evaluated using both predictive-performance and group-fairness metrics(Kiashemshaki et al., 2025)。这些机制与额外计算的相互作用不同：基于验证者的选择、基于协议的聚合和基于判断的重新排名不需要以与预算增加相同的速度提高. These regimes interact differently with additional compute: verifier-based selection, agreement-based aggregation, and judge-based re-ranking need not improve at the same rate as budget increases(Cobbe et al., 2021; Lightman et al., 2023; Zheng et al., 2023).

由于开放权重推理检查点在验证监督、偏好目标和内置推理预算控制方面存在重大差异，Because open-weight reasoning checkpoints differ materially in verified supervision, preference objectives, and built-in reasoning-budget controls,Section˜D.2分别总结了这些系统级杠杆。summarizes these system-level levers separately.

基准结构还应该与任务的交互模型相匹配。单轮精确答案任务探测正确终端叶子的发现，而交互式代理基准测试则评估完整的轨迹，包括从中间错误中恢复The benchmark structure should also match the task’s interaction model. Single-turn exact-answer tasks probe discovery of a correct terminal leaf, whereas interactive agent benchmarks evaluate full trajectories, including recovery from intermediate errors(Yao et al., 2024; Welleck et al., 2024)。对于涉及敏感披露的交互式聊天机器人任务，生态有效性还需要对用户的上下文隐私决策和界面暴露的保护行为进行建模. For interactive chatbot tasks involving sensitive disclosures, ecological validity also requires modeling users’ contextual privacy decisions and the protective actions exposed by the interface(Nezhad et al., 2026)。因此，相同的推理算法在“任何正确样本”报告下可能显得很强，但在轨迹级可靠性指标下却很弱（. The same inference algorithm can therefore appear strong under “any correct sample” reporting yet weak under trajectory-level reliability metrics (Section˜3.4).

新鲜度和难度校准很重要，尤其是在测试时间缩放下。基准标签完整性也很重要，因为制造数据集中基于视觉语言模型的噪声和语义不一致标签的清理可能会严重影响下游分类的准确性Freshness and difficulty calibration matter especially under test-time scaling. Benchmark-label integrity is also essential, as vision-language-model-based sanitation of noisy and semantically inconsistent labels in manufacturing datasets can materially affect downstream classification accuracy(Mahjourian & Nguyen, 2026)。污染限制基准和时间分段数据集有助于区分真正的搜索或验证收益与记忆. Contamination-limited benchmarks and time-segmented datasets help distinguish genuine search or verification gains from memorization(White et al., 2025; Jain et al., 2025; Oren et al., 2024)。基准测试还应该避免饱和：如果任务太简单，额外的计算效果就很小；如果它们都很难，那么缩放曲线就会变平，因为很少能达到正确的解决方案。由于许多推理基准都很小，数据集大小直接限制了缩放比较的统计分辨率. Benchmarks should also avoid saturation: if tasks are too easy, additional compute has little effect; if they are uniformly difficult, scaling curves flatten because correct solutions are rarely reachable. Since many reasoning benchmarks are small, dataset size directly limits the statistical resolution of scaling comparisons(Snell et al., 2025; Miller, 2024; Ye et al., 2024)（见(seeSection˜3.5).

因此，抽样报告应指定代币度量、支持门、参考分数空间、门 排序、确定性操作或随机抽取、状态更新、停止和长度规则、数量 样本、种子或随机配置策略，以及任何近似或回退行为。这些细节 不是实现琐事：它们定义了推理轨迹上的提案分布，因此 正在评估测试时间缩放系统。A sampling report should therefore specify the token measure, support gates, reference score space, gate ordering, deterministic actions or stochastic draws, state updates, stopping and length rules, number of samples, seeds or randomized configuration policy, and any approximation or fallback behavior. These details are not implementation trivia: they define the proposal distribution over reasoning traces and therefore the test-time scaling system being evaluated.

3.3 采样推理下的聚合和停止Aggregation and stopping under sampled inference

抽样候选银行本身并不定义提交的预测。推理协议必须说明如何从每个跟踪中提取证据以及如何将固定的完整银行转换为输出。如果推出的数量或长度是自适应的，则协议还必须指定生成停止的时间。这种分离很重要，因为更有力的证据或不同的决策规则可以在不降低发电成本的情况下提高准确性。A sampled candidate bank does not by itself define the submitted prediction. The inference protocol must say how evidence is extracted from each trace and how a fixed, completed bank is converted into an output. If either the number or length of rollouts is adaptive, the protocol must also specify when generation stops. This separation matters because stronger evidence or a different decision rule can improve accuracy without reducing generation cost.

These are decision structures, not evidence sources. If the output contains both a canonical answer and a rationale, the protocol must also specify which trace accompanies the winning answer.

分数语义是算法的一部分。Score semantics are part of the algorithm.

命名记分器并不完全指定分数感知减速器。协议必须说明分数的来源、值是否越大越好，以及如何降低令牌级别或步骤级别的分数。答案规范化和无效输出处理决定哪些候选者进入规则。分数转换、温度和过滤阈值决定证据如何进入决策。该协议还必须定义联系和后备，并识别任何评估者提示或模型。校准参数和其他可调值必须固定在保留的数据上，而不是测试标签上。Naming the scorer does not fully specify a score-aware reducer. The protocol must state where scores come from, whether larger values are better, and how token- or step-level scores are reduced. Answer canonicalization and invalid-output handling determine which candidates enter the rule. Score transformations, temperatures, and filtering thresholds determine how evidence enters the decision. The protocol must also define ties and fallbacks, and identify any evaluator prompts or models. Calibration parameters and other tunable values must be fixed on held-out data, not test labels.

仅限订单的规则，例如硬性最佳-Order-only rules such as hard Best-of-NN、基于排名的过滤、排名投票和最佳多数对于保持联系的严格增加分数转换是不变的。基于原始总和或均值、softmax 权重或对数赔率的规则则不然。序列和平均对数概率施加不同的长度偏好。原始验证者分数不必是校准概率，校准对数赔率可能会将负面证据分配给低分候选人, rank-based filtering, rank voting, and Majority-of-the-Bests are invariant to strictly increasing score transformations that preserve ties. Rules based on raw sums or means, softmax weights, or log-odds are not. Sequence and mean log-probability impose different length preferences. A raw verifier score need not be a calibrated probability, and calibrated log-odds may assign negative evidence to low-scoring candidates(Taubenfeld et al., 2025; Kuang et al., 2026)。通过硬最大化，代理评分错误的风险会随着银行的发展而增加. With hard maximization, exposure to proxy-score errors increases as the bank grows(Gao et al., 2023; Huang et al., 2025).

因果停止。Causal stopping.

只有当因果控制器停止未来的工作时，发电成本才会下降；证据提取和固定银行选择在其所需的痕迹完成后进行。让Generation cost can fall only when a causal controller stops future work; evidence extraction and fixed-bank selection act after their required traces are complete. Let

ℋn=σ​(x,(Yi,ai,mi)i≤n)\mathcal{H}_{n}=\sigma\!\left(x,(Y_{i},a_{i},m_{i})_{i\leq n}\right)

是之后可用的信息be the information available afternn已完成推出。跨推出规则是有界的停止时间completed rollouts. An across-rollout rule is a bounded stopping timeτroll≤Nmax\tau_{\mathrm{roll}}\leq N_{\max}满意的satisfying{τroll≤n}∈ℋn\{\tau_{\mathrm{roll}}\leq n\}\in\mathcal{H}_{n}，其最终决定可能仅使用通过观察到的银行, and its final decision may use only the bank observed throughτroll\tau_{\mathrm{roll}}。简单来说，该过程是否因推出而停止. In plain terms, whether the procedure has stopped by rolloutnn可能取决于第一个may depend on the firstnn已完成推出，但不适用于任何后续候选者或元数据。当当前计数领先者的潜在质量大于其第二者的潜在质量的后验概率超过阈值时，自适应一致性停止，而提前停止自我一致性在有效的一致答案窗口后停止completed rollouts, but not on any later candidate or metadata. Adaptive-Consistency stops when the posterior probability that the current count leader has greater latent mass than its runner-up crosses a threshold, whereas Early-Stopping Self-Consistency stops after a valid unanimous answer window(Aggarwal et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024)。停止策略将选择器的重复应用与继续标准和最大预算结合起来。. A stopping policy combines repeated application of the selector with a continuation criterion and a maximum budget.

用于推出For rolloutii, 让, letℱi,t\mathcal{F}_{i,t}通过令牌包含允许的先前历史记录和当前推出的信息contain the permitted prior history and the current rollout’s information through tokentt。推出内停止时间. A within-rollout stopping timeτtok\tau_{\mathrm{tok}}满足satisfies{τtok≤t}∈ℱi,t\{\tau_{\mathrm{tok}}\leq t\}\in\mathcal{F}_{i,t}：它不能使用隐藏后缀或最终答案来决定是否截断当前跟踪。例如，DeepConf 使用已完成的预热跟踪来校准置信度阈值，并且当滑动窗口令牌置信度低于该阈值时可能会终止后续跟踪: it cannot use the hidden suffix or eventual answer to decide whether to truncate the current trace. DeepConf, for example, uses completed warm-up traces to calibrate a confidence threshold and may terminate later traces when sliding-window token confidence falls below it(Fu et al., 2026)。跨转出规则只能避免稍后的跟踪，而转出内规则也可以避免当前跟踪的后缀。已完成跟踪的离线过滤可能会更改返回的答案，但不会保存生成令牌。. Across-rollout rules can avoid only later traces, whereas within-rollout rules can also avoid a suffix of the current trace. Offline filtering of completed traces may change the returned answer but saves no generation tokens.

已记录的固定银行只能通过因果追溯重播来支持在线索赔。候选顺序必须独立于结果而确定，并且每个模拟动作只能检查当时显示的历史记录。模拟截止隐藏了所有后续标记和候选人的最终答案。校准仅使用先前指定的迹线，调整数据与测试集分开。成本核算包括预热样本、丢弃的样本以及从未触发停止条件的运行。任何其他重播都使用已部署的控制器不可用的信息或计算。A recorded fixed bank can support an online claim only through causal retrospective replay. Candidate order must be fixed independently of outcomes, and each simulated action can inspect only the history revealed at that point. A simulated cutoff hides all later tokens and the candidate’s eventual answer. Calibration uses only previously designated traces, with tuning data kept separate from the test set. Cost accounting includes warm-up samples, discarded samples, and runs in which the stopping condition never fires. Any other replay uses information or compute unavailable to the deployed controller.

比较和计算会计。Comparison and compute accounting.

A 共享银行shared-bank比较衡量以一个完整银行为条件的聚合。每个离线协议接收相同的序列化候选者，并且仅接收允许使用的推理时间元数据。控股comparison measures aggregation conditional on one completed bank. Each offline protocol receives the same serialized candidates and only the inference-time metadata it is permitted to use. HoldingEηE_{\eta}、解析、规范化、候选资格和分数转换固定隔离, parsing, canonicalization, candidate eligibility, and score transformations fixed isolates𝒢δ\mathcal{G}_{\delta};否则，这些差异属于比较的后代协议。如果证据和决策成分都不同，则比较涵盖整个生成后阶段; otherwise, those differences belong to the compared post-generation protocols. If both evidence and decision components vary, the comparison covers the full post-generation stage(Eη,𝒢δ)(E_{\eta},\mathcal{G}_{\delta})根据固定提案并实现银行。这两种变体都无法估计自适应停止或不同发电策略引起的变化带来的节省。超出已实现银行的概括仍然需要对提示和候选抽签进行不确定性估计。安under a fixed proposal and realized bank. Neither variant can estimate savings from adaptive stopping or changes caused by a different generation policy. Generalization beyond the realized bank still requires uncertainty estimates over prompts and candidate draws. An端到端end-to-end相反，比较允许每个完整的协议生成自己的流，获取自己的证据，执行其停止规则，并通过以下方式进行评估comparison instead allows each complete protocol to generate its own stream, acquire its own evidence, execute its stopping rule, and be evaluated byMBM_{B}.

匹配预算应分解为The matched budget should decompose as

Ctotal=Cgen+Ceval,Ceval=Csignal+Ccontrol+Cdecision.C_{\mathrm{total}}=C_{\mathrm{gen}}+C_{\mathrm{eval}},\qquad C_{\mathrm{eval}}=C_{\mathrm{signal}}+C_{\mathrm{control}}+C_{\mathrm{decision}}.

该核算包括预热和丢弃的令牌、验证者或判断者调用、重复的控制器评估以及聚合本身。相同的样本计数并不意味着相同的计算：外部评分增加了候选成本，而朴素的成对 MBR 需要This accounting includes warm-up and discarded tokens, verifier or judge calls, repeated controller evaluations, and aggregation itself. Equal sample counts need not imply equal compute: external scoring adds candidate-wise cost, and naive pairwise MBR requiresO​(n2)O(n^{2})效用评估utility evaluations(Cheng & Vlachos, 2023; Jinnai & Ariu, 2024)。无法以相应单位表示的成本应与标量预算一起单独报告。检查点端压缩同样可以在固定的代币预算下移动挂钟前沿：Qwen3-VL 的结构化层修剪产生了可测量的首次代币时间增益，同时保留了大部分（但不是全部）基准性能. Costs that cannot be expressed in commensurate units should be reported separately alongside any scalar budget. Checkpoint-side compression can likewise move the wall-clock frontier at a fixed token budget: structured layer pruning of Qwen3-VL produced measurable time-to-first-token gains while retaining most, but not all, benchmark performance(Madinei et al., 2025)。应根据总成本绘制端到端效用。相反，共享银行的结果确定了可归因于生成后聚合阶段的差异，并且固定证据缩小了对决策规则的归因。发现-稳定性概况. End-to-end utility should be plotted against total cost. Shared-bank results instead identify differences attributable to the post-generation aggregation stage, and holding evidence fixed narrows attribution to the decision rule. The discovery–stability profile inSection˜3.4仍然是补充性的，因为它描述了提案下候选者的可用性，而不是特定聚合协议的成功概率。remains complementary because it describes candidate availability under the proposal, not the success probability of a particular aggregation protocol.

对于重复采样诊断，修复建议或推理协议 产生完整的候选人。让For repeated-sampling diagnostics, fix the proposal or inference protocol that produces completed candidates. 3.5 再现性Reproducibility

在测试时间缩放下，必须重现的对象是随机推理协议，而不是模型检查点。机器学习和自然语言处理中的可重复性规范询问独立研究人员是否可以从规定的代码、数据和程序中获得兼容的结果，以及报告的分数是否带有解释它们所需的开发痕迹、预算和可变性Under test-time scaling the object that must reproduce is a randomized inference protocol, not a model checkpoint. Reproducibility norms in machine learning and natural language processing ask whether independent researchers can obtain compatible results from the stated code, data, and procedure, and whether reported scores carry the development traces, budgets, and variability needed to interpret them(Pineau et al., 2021; Dodge et al., 2019; Bouthillier et al., 2021)。叶级运行从提案中提取或在构建候选银行时因果性地停止. A leaf-level run draws, or causally stops while constructing, a candidate bank from the proposalqπ(⋅∣x)q_{\pi}(\cdot\mid x)由提示、解码器和预算引起（induced by the prompt, decoder, and budget (Section˜3.2）。它计算推理时间证据并应用固定银行决策（). It computes inference-time evidence and applies a fixed-bank decision (Section˜3.3）在对提交的输出或候选银行进行评分之前（) before scoring the submitted output or candidate bank (Section˜3.4）。因此，该银行是蒙特卡罗实验的一种实现。重温这种认识和再现它估计的数量是不同的目标。). The bank is therefore one realization of a Monte Carlo experiment. Replaying that realization and reproducing the quantity it estimates are different goals.精确重播Exact replay重建相同的候选文本、推理时间信号、停止和聚合决策，并报告来自相同项目、权重、分词器、聊天模板、解码配置、随机数流、软件堆栈和硬件的分数；它承保审计、调试和回归测试。reconstructs the same candidate texts, inference-time signals, stopping and aggregation decisions, and reported scores from the same items, weights, tokenizer, chat template, decoding configuration, random-number streams, software stack, and hardware; it underwrites auditing, debugging, and regression testing.分布再现性Distributional reproducibility相反，要求独立重新运行已声明的协议，返回同一估计值的统计上兼容的估计值，例如instead asks that an independent rerun of the declared protocol return statistically compatible estimates of the same estimand, such asMBM_{B}, 简介, the profileSkS_{k}，或法官定义的胜率。这样的主张预设了诚实重播将展示的变化模型。固定种子使一份成绩单可审核，但既不能表征提示、候选人抽签和判断呼叫的可变性，也不能表征数字执行的可变性；将单种子运行视为可复制性的证据，并仅改变种子作为完整的不确定性分析，是反复出现的错误, or a judge-defined win rate. Such a claim presupposes a model of the variation an honest rerun would exhibit. Fixing a seed makes one transcript auditable but characterizes neither the variability over prompts, candidate draws, and judge calls nor that of numerical execution; treating a single seeded run as evidence of replicability, and varying only the seed as a complete uncertainty analysis, are recurring errors(Bethard, 2022).

这种变化既有统计来源又有程序来源This variation has both statistical and procedural sources(Miller, 2024; Blackwell et al., 2024)，并且每个都进入前缀树管道的不同阶段。该提案由每个前缀本地解码选择决定，包括温度、截断门的顺序、确定性令牌操作、停止和长度规则以及任何自适应预算控制器。这些设置构成, and each enters at a distinct stage of the prefix-tree pipeline. The proposal is fixed by every prefix-local decoding choice, including temperature, the ordering of truncation gates, deterministic token actions, stopping and length rules, and any adaptive budget controller. These settings constituteqπq_{\pi}而不仅仅是实现它（rather than merely implement it (Section˜3.2）。候选库不需要独立同分布：共享前缀搜索状态、自适应停止决策、验证者反馈、工具状态或依赖于调度程序的随机数流的样本是相关的，这使得重复采样诊断的独立尝试读取无效。). The candidate bank need not be i.i.d.: samples that share prefix-search state, adaptive stopping decisions, verifier feedback, tool state, or a scheduler-dependent random-number stream are dependent, which voids the independent-attempt reading that the repeated-sampling diagnostics ofSection˜3.4依靠。生成并不固定解释或评估图。答案提取器、规范化器、单元测试工具、判断提示和成对排序可以以不同的方式处理相同的完成。 LLM 法官的职位、冗长程度和协议敏感性会影响聚合规则或基准指标，具体取决于法官的使用位置rely on. Generation does not fix the interpretation or evaluation map. Answer extractors, canonicalizers, unit-test harnesses, judge prompts, and pairwise orderings can treat the same completion differently. The position, verbosity, and protocol sensitivities of LLM judges then affect either the aggregation rule or the benchmark metric, depending on where the judge is used(Zheng et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2025)。数值执行同样不是惰性的：当 logits 接近时，精度存在差异. Numerical execution is likewise not inert: when logits are close, differences in precision(Hariri et al., 2026b)、内核或批处理可以翻转发出的令牌并将其沿着长推理轨迹传播，因此即使是贪婪解码也不需要是确定性的, kernels, or batching can flip the emitted token and propagate it along a long reasoning trace, so even greedy decoding need not be deterministic(Hochlehnert et al., 2025; Yuan et al., 2025)，并且推理结果的运行间差异应该直接测量，而不是被高平均分掩盖, and the resulting run-to-run variability in reasoning outcomes should be measured directly rather than masked by a high average score(Liu et al., 2025a).

可检查的工件是银行及其来源：呈现的提示、原始完成、解析的答案、令牌或步骤级元数据、验证者和判断笔录、转换后的分数、停止和聚合决策以及每个候选者的随机流。发布这些记录，就像在透明的评估框架和最近的可重复性审计中一样，可以让其他人将原始候选质量与聚合和停止协议的行为分开The checkable artifact is the bank together with its provenance: rendered prompts, raw completions, parsed answers, token- or step-level metadata, verifier and judge transcripts, transformed scores, stopping and aggregation decisions, and the per-candidate random stream. Releasing these records, as in transparent evaluation frameworks and recent reproducibility audits, lets others separate raw candidate quality from the behavior of the aggregation and stopping protocol(Liang et al., 2023; Hochlehnert et al., 2025)。该协议还确定估计值。预算样本. The protocol also determines the estimand. The sample budgetNN因此，在检查结果之前必须声明温度、证据图、聚合和停止控制、提取规则和种子时间表。在看到结果后更改它们会将评估转变为测试集上的选择，并且任何验证集调整都属于报告而不是标题数字。在执行之前，应通过从运行、提示、样本索引和流名称到基于计数器的随机状态的确定性映射来固定样本身份。这可以防止异步批处理更改附加到每个候选的变量。, temperature, evidence map, aggregation and stopping controls, extraction rules, and seed schedule must therefore be declared before outcomes are inspected. Changing them after seeing results turns evaluation into selection on the test set, and any validation-set tuning belongs in the report rather than in the headline number. Sample identities should be fixed before execution through a deterministic map from run, prompt, sample index, and stream name to a counter-based random state. This keeps asynchronous batching from changing which variate is attached to each candidate.

量化变异性。Quantifying variability.

分布再现性只能通过与报告数量相匹配的不确定性估计来检查。对于二元结果Distributional reproducibility is checkable only through an uncertainty estimate that matches the reported quantity. For a binary outcomezq∈{0,1}z_{q}\in\{0,1\}数据集成功率with dataset success ratep^=1Q​∑q=1Qzq\hat{p}=\frac{1}{Q}\sum_{q=1}^{Q}z_{q}，威尔逊间隔保持稳定，当, Wilson intervals remain stable whenQQ很小或者is small orp^\hat{p}接近于is close to0 or 11 (Wilson, 1927)。对于重复采样泛函，例如. For repeated-sampling functionals such asPass​@​k=Sk,1\mathrm{Pass}@k=S_{k,1}，阈值轮廓, the threshold profileSk,tS_{k,t}或基于判断的聚合，闭合形式方差表达式很少可用，因为它们依赖于聚合协议。非参数引导程序可以重新采样提示并重新计算完整的统计数据, or judge-based aggregates, closed-form variance expressions are rarely available because they depend on the aggregation protocol. A nonparametric bootstrap can instead resample prompts and recompute the full statistic(Efron, 1979);当项目共享上下文或文档状态时，应在该集群级别进行重新采样。程序必须是; when items share context or document state, resampling should occur at that cluster level. The procedure must be协议一致protocol-consistent：如果报告的输出或分数是通过聚合产生的: if the reported output or score is produced by aggregation overNN样本，其变异性必须通过该聚合规则传播，而不是通过更简单的代理来近似。两个系统的比较应该在共享提示集上配对，并且在协议允许的情况下，在对齐的样本索引或公共随机流上配对，这消除了项目难度，而不意味着系统是确定性的。当这些估计被省略时，测试时间扩展报告中常见的小样本预算可以将系统从一次重新运行重新排序到下一次重新运行；如果没有与协议匹配的不确定性估计，则报告的排名不是分布上可重现的声明samples, its variability must be propagated through that aggregation rule rather than approximated by a simpler surrogate. Comparisons of two systems should be paired on the shared prompt set and, where the protocols allow, on aligned sample indices or common random streams, which cancels item difficulty without implying that the systems are deterministic. When these estimates are omitted, the small sample budgets common in test-time scaling reports can reorder systems from one rerun to the next; without a protocol-matched uncertainty estimate, the reported ranking is not a distributionally reproducible claim(Miller, 2024; Ye et al., 2024; Hariri et al., 2026c; a).

数字和服务设置。Numerical and serving settings.

因此，数值执行必须与解码一样精确地指定：推理库、权重、激活、注意力和键值缓存的数值格式，以及任何量化方案都应与解码、聚合和停止设置一起包含在报告中，因为低位量化尤其会降低最难项目的推理能力Numerical execution must therefore be specified as precisely as decoding: the inference library, the numerical formats for weights, activations, attention, and the key–value cache, and any quantization scheme belong in the report alongside the decoding, aggregation, and stopping settings, since low-bit quantization in particular can degrade reasoning on the hardest items(Liu et al., 2025b)。然后对项目子集进行 FP32 或更高精度的审核，将算法与数值变化分开. An FP32 or higher-precision audit on a subset of items then separates algorithmic from numerical variation(Yuan et al., 2025)。模型状态完整性是服务端的另一个问题：位翻转可能会破坏语言模型参数和输出，并且已经提出了轻量级张量审计方法来在推理时检测和恢复此类故障. Model-state integrity is an additional serving-side concern: bit flips can corrupt language-model parameters and outputs, and lightweight tensor-auditing methods have been proposed to detect and recover such faults at inference time(Tahmasivand et al., 2025).

所声明的再现性目标决定了必须控制的内容：确定性内核、固定批处理计划和序列化库的精确重放调用，而通过上述独立执行的协议一致的不确定性可以更好地满足能力声明。精确重播确保可审核性；通过与协议相匹配的不确定性估计来证明的分布再现性使得测试时间缩放方法之间的比较具有科学意义。Which reproducibility target is claimed dictates what must be controlled: exact replay calls for deterministic kernels, fixed batch schedules, and serialized banks, whereas a capability claim is better served by the protocol-consistent uncertainty over independent executions described above. Exact replay secures auditability; distributional reproducibility, certified by an uncertainty estimate matched to the protocol, is what makes comparisons between test-time scaling methods scientifically meaningful.

4 实证研究和追踪语料库Empirical Study and Trace Corpus

我们的实证研究使用固定响应银行来衡量额外的速度 抽样揭示了正确的候选者以及实际减速器选择的频率 一。该版本保留了响应、结果和记录的信号，因此是新的 可以在不重新生成响应的情况下评估减速器。它的四个街区跨越 不同的任务、模型名册、采样协议和信号细节级别 （Our empirical study uses fixed response banks to measure how quickly additional sampling reveals a correct candidate and how often practical reducers select one. The release retains the responses, outcomes, and recorded signals, so new reducers can be evaluated without regenerating responses. Its four blocks span different tasks, model rosters, sampling protocols, and levels of signal detail (Table˜1）。因此，我们单独报告每个块。). We therefore report each block separately.

4.1 跨知识和符号推理的广泛评估Broad evaluation across knowledge and symbolic reasoning

4.4 参考辅助和无参考验证器信号Reference-assisted and reference-free verifier signals

信号丰富的块记录一个参考辅助分数和一个 无参考分数。 CompassVerifier-3B (OpenCompass) 收到问题， 参考答案和考生反应并预测 A/B/C 是否正确， 不正确或无效的回复The signal-rich blocks record one reference-assisted score and one reference-free score. CompassVerifier-3B (OpenCompass) receives the question, reference answer, and candidate response and predicts A/B/C for correct, incorrect, or invalid responses(Liu et al., 2025c)。我们保留其 直接标签分布和零基线调整上下文分布。 参考依赖评分是一种结果诊断，不能用于 当黄金答案不可用时的推理时间选择。. We retain both its direct label distribution and a null-baseline-adjusted contextual distribution. The reference-dependent score is an outcome diagnostic and cannot be used for inference-time selection when gold answers are unavailable.

我们的无参考分数是成对的逐点适应 LLM作为验证者方法Our reference-free score is a pointwise adaptation of the pairwise LLM-as-a-Verifier method(Kwok et al., 2026)。 Qwen3.6只看到一个 问题和一名候选人的回应。它没有收到参考答案或基本事实， 指南针结果，或其他候选。它分别 批评问题的理解、推理的有效性以及结论是否正确 得到支持，然后为每个标准分配一个序数 A–T 分数。我们映射A 从 T 到 20 到 1，取返回值下的预期序数分数， 可见质量重整化评分标记概率，将其标准化为. Qwen3.6 sees only one problem and one candidate response. It receives no reference answer or ground truth, Compass result, or other candidate. It separately critiques problem understanding, reasoning validity, and whether the conclusion is supported, then assigns each criterion an ordinal A–T score. We map A through T to 20 through 1, take the expected ordinal score under the returned, visible-mass-renormalized scoring-token probabilities, normalize it to[0,1][0,1]，并对三个标准进行平均。该信号可以对候选人进行排名 没有黄金答案，它是一个序数评估分数。准确的提示、解码通行证、得分方程、 上下文处理和审计计数在, and average the three criteria. This signal can rank candidates without a gold answer and it is an ordinal evaluator score. The exact prompts, decoding passes, score equations, context handling, and audit counts are given inSection˜G.6.

5 结论Conclusion

测试时间缩放是一系列预算推理算法。在隐式前缀树上查看这些算法将单轨迹审议、叶级采样和缩减以及前缀级搜索分开，同时将提案、证据图、决策规则和因果停止控制器暴露为推理过程的不同组成部分。因此，具有科学意义的比较对象是完整的推理系统。Test-time scaling is a family of budgeted inference algorithms. Viewing these algorithms over the implicit prefix tree separates single-trajectory deliberation, leaf-level sampling and reduction, and prefix-level search, while exposing the proposal, evidence map, decision rule, and causal stopping controller as distinct components of the inference process. The scientifically meaningful object of comparison is therefore the complete inference system.

这种观点自然决定了应该如何评估推理系统。端到端实用程序和候选库诊断回答不同的问题；共享银行和端到端比较支持不同的主张；计算会计必须包括生成、评估、控制和决策；并且不确定性必须通过部署的推理协议传播。我们的框架还通过发现稳定性概况统一重复采样评估，并将精确重放与分布再现性区分开来。随附的语料库包含 1,948,821 个完整的推理轨迹，涵盖广泛的知识、符号推理和竞争数学，包括令牌级候选对数概率和信号丰富的块中的两个验证器系列。This perspective naturally determines how reasoning systems should be evaluated. End-to-end utility and candidate-bank diagnostics answer different questions; shared-bank and end-to-end comparisons support different claims; compute accounting must include generation, evaluation, control, and decision; and uncertainty must propagate through the deployed inference protocol. Our framework also unifies repeated-sampling evaluation through the discovery–stability profile and distinguishes exact replay from distributional reproducibility. The accompanying corpus comprises 1,948,821 full reasoning traces spanning broad knowledge, symbolic reasoning, and competition mathematics, including token-level candidate log probabilities and two verifier families in the signal-rich blocks.

我们的实证研究证明了这种系统级观点的实际后果。排名随着标题、抽样预算、基准和承诺标准的变化而变化；预测轨迹内正确性的运行时信号不需要可靠地对模型进行排序；严格的提取可能会将弃权与错误混为一谈。我们的结果表明，测试时间扩展的进展应该使用可重复的推理系统来衡量，该系统的推理协议、计算预算和不确定性都被明确报告，而不是通过在不完全指定的程序下评估的检查点来衡量。Our empirical study demonstrates the practical consequences of this system-level view. Rankings change with the rubric, sampling budget, benchmark, and commitment standard; runtime signals that predict correctness within trajectories need not reliably rank models; and strict extraction can conflate abstention with error. Our results argue that progress in test-time scaling should be measured using reproducible inference systems whose inference protocols, compute budgets, and uncertainties are explicitly reported, rather than by checkpoints evaluated under incompletely specified procedures.

B.4 代理错误指定和正规化选择Proxy misspecification and regularized selection

More generally, one can combine proxy scores with agreement or Bayes-risk terms so that the selected candidate is not determined by the proxy alone(Jinnai et al., 2025; Verdun et al., 2025)。因为减速器是被评估的推理系统的一部分，所以改变选择的强度或正则化会改变比较的对象。. Because the reducer is part of the inference system being evaluated, changing the strength or regularization of selection changes the object under comparison.

B.5 答案选择与理由陈述Answer selection versus rationale presentation

对于许多推理任务，基准测试效用仅取决于最终答案，而不取决于确切的基本原理字符串。因此，将答案选择与理由陈述分开是有用的：For many reasoning tasks, benchmark utility depends only on the final answer rather than on the exact rationale string. It is therefore useful to separate answer selection from rationale presentation:

a^=arg⁡maxa⁡q^N​(a∣x),i⋆∈arg⁡maxi:ai=a^⁡T~​(x,Yi).\hat{a}=\arg\max_{a}\hat{q}_{N}(a\mid x),\qquad i^{\star}\in\arg\max_{i:\,a_{i}=\hat{a}}\tilde{T}(x,Y_{i}).

第一个决策选择应该返回的答案；第二个根据合理质量分数进行选择The first decision chooses the answer that should be returned; the second chooses, according to a rationale-quality scoreT~\tilde{T}（例如，学习到的分数(for example, the learned scorejij_{i}），其中采样的基本原理应显示为该答案的代表性解释。将这些决策分开可以防止静默恢复到全字符串 MAP 选择，即使答案正确，也不需要优化输出质量), which sampled rationale should be shown as a representative explanation for that answer. Keeping these decisions separate prevents silent reversion to full-string MAP selection, which need not optimize output quality even when the answer is correct(Eikema & Aziz, 2020).

附录CAppendix C前缀级搜索：控制器和评估器变体Prefix-level search: controller and evaluator variants

前缀搜索使用未完成状态的分数来分配计算，对评估产生三种结果：本地评估和控制分解为单独的设计选择，搜索将提议分布转移到叶子上，并且前缀方法在轴上消耗计算，如果仅报告已完成的候选数，则这些轴是不可见的。Prefix search allocates computation using scores on unfinished states, with three consequences for evaluation: local evaluation and control factorize into separate design choices, search shifts the proposal distribution over leaves, and prefix methods consume compute on axes that are invisible if one reports only the number of completed candidates.

C.1 评估器-控制器分解Evaluator–controller factorization

前缀级搜索过程可以写成对A prefix-level search procedure can be written as a pair(S,πctrl)(S,\pi_{\mathrm{ctrl}}), 其中, whereSS将部分状态映射到分数或汇总统计数据，并且maps a partial state to a score or summary statistic andπctrl\pi_{\mathrm{ctrl}}使用这些摘要来选择元操作，uses those summaries to choose meta-actions,

at∼πctrl(⋅∣x,ℱt,𝒴t,bt).a_{t}\sim\pi_{\mathrm{ctrl}}(\cdot\mid x,\mathcal{F}_{t},\mathcal{Y}_{t},b_{t}).

行动The actionata_{t}可以指定要扩展哪个节点、要生成多少个后继者、要分配多少个转出、要修剪哪些状态或何时终止。集束搜索、最佳优先搜索、思想树式搜索、RAP 和 MCTS 式程序都用不同的评分器和控制规则实例化了这种评估器-控制器模式may specify which node to expand, how many successors to generate, how many rollouts to allocate, which states to prune, or when to terminate. Beam search, best-first search, Tree-of-Thoughts-style search, RAP, and MCTS-style procedures all instantiate this evaluator–controller pattern with different scorers and control rules(Kocsis & Szepesvári, 2006; Browne et al., 2012; Yao et al., 2023; Hao et al., 2023)。这种因式分解在消融中很有用：改进可能来自更好的局部评估、更好的计算分配，或两者兼而有之。. This factorization is useful in ablations: improvements may come from better local evaluation, better compute allocation, or both.

C.2 搜索引起的提案转变Search-induced proposal shift

任何控制器及其记分器和停止规则都会产生有效的叶子分布Any controller together with its scorer and stopping rule induces an effective leaf distribution

qsearch,B​(y∣x)=Pr⁡(y^B​(x)=y),q_{\mathrm{search},B}(y\mid x)=\Pr\bigl(\hat{y}_{B}(x)=y\bigr),

这通常与解码器引发的提案不同which generally differs from the decoder-induced proposalqπ​(y∣x)q_{\pi}(y\mid x);当搜索返回银行而不是单个叶子时，相应的对象是返回银行的每叶子包含概率（; when the search returns a bank rather than a single leaf, the corresponding object is the per-leaf inclusion probability of the returned bank (Section˜2.4）。因此，前缀搜索不仅是一个计算分配器，而且还是一个提案整形器。这对于评估很重要，因为搜索返回的银行是相关的，并且偏向于控制器探索的分支机构。阈值指标，例如). Prefix search is therefore not only a compute allocator but also a proposal shaper. This matters for evaluation because banks returned by search are correlated and biased toward branches that the controller explored. Threshold metrics such asPass​@​k\mathrm{Pass}@k和轮廓坐标and the profile coordinatesS^k,tbank\widehat{S}^{\mathrm{bank}}_{k,t} (Section˜3.4）仍然可以在这样的库上计算，但它们应该被解释为搜索引起的库的描述性摘要，除非实验协议明确地对完整搜索算法的重复执行进行平均。) can still be computed on such banks, but they should be interpreted as descriptive summaries of the search-induced bank unless the experimental protocol explicitly averages over repeated executions of the full search algorithm.

当WhenSS是一种学习的奖励或价值模型，前缀搜索继承了常见的代理错误指定问题，并添加了分支消除失败模式：有希望的分支可以在从该分支生成任何高效用叶子之前被修剪。这种故障模式在纯叶级重新排序中没有直接的模拟，其中候选者在选择之前就已经存在is a learned reward or value model, prefix search inherits the familiar problem of proxy misspecification and adds a branch-elimination failure mode: a promising branch may be pruned before any high-utility leaf from that branch is ever generated. This failure mode has no direct analog in pure leaf-level reranking, where the candidate already exists before selection(Gao et al., 2023; Hung et al., 2025).

C.3 计算会计Compute accounting

除了最终生成之外，前缀搜索还会产生部分状态评分、部署和树维护的计算成本。因此，仅报告已完成的叶子数量可能会产生误导：两种方法可能会返回相同数量的叶子，但使用的模型计算和评估器计算量却截然不同。至少，经验比较应该将生成代币成本与评估者成本分开，并注意专用系统是否支持共享前缀执行。这种区别很重要，因为树形结构内核可以通过键值缓存重用来利用前缀共享，从而大大改变基于搜索的方法的壁钟前沿Prefix search incurs compute costs for partial-state scoring, rollouts, and tree maintenance, in addition to final generations. Reporting only the number of completed leaves can therefore be misleading: two methods may return the same number of leaves while using very different amounts of model computation and evaluator computation. At minimum, empirical comparisons should separate generated-token cost from evaluator cost, and note whether specialized systems support shared-prefix execution. This distinction matters because tree-structured kernels can exploit prefix sharing through key–value cache reuse, substantially changing the wall-clock frontier for search-based methods(Yao et al., 2025).

附录DAppendix D推理法学硕士和评估模型Reasoning LLMs and Evaluated Models

最近的开放式法学硕士已经产生了一个独特的类别Recent open-weight LLMs have produced a distinct class of推理模型reasoning models经过训练或配置为针对数学、科学和代码中的多跳问题发出中间推理步骤。在实践中，这些收益很少仅来自额外的预训练；它们主要来自模型端适应和推理接口：使用明确的推理轨迹、可验证的奖励或偏好信号，使预训练的主干适应结构化问题解决，以及配置在推理时如何引发或预算推理。trained or configured to emit intermediate reasoning steps for multi-hop problems in mathematics, science, and code. In practice, these gains rarely come from additional pretraining alone; they arise primarily from model-side adaptation and inference interfaces: adapting a pretrained backbone to structured problem solving using explicit reasoning traces, verifiable rewards, or preference signals, and configuring how reasoning is elicited or budgeted at inference time.Figure˜1给出了将这些发展与推理时间标度联系起来的正文年表；本附录提供了我们评估中使用的详细分类法和代表性开放权重模型描述，强调最直接影响推理准确性、鲁棒性和推理成本的设计选择。gives the main-text chronology connecting these developments to inference-time scaling; this appendix provides the detailed taxonomy and representative open-weight model descriptions used in our evaluation, emphasizing the design choices that most directly affect reasoning accuracy, robustness, and inference cost.

D.1 常见的培训后管道原型Common Post-Training Pipeline Archetypes

最近的开放权重推理管道主要分为三种反复出现的训练后原型。参数高效的适应也已扩展到分散的设置，其中客户端交换低等级更新而不集中其私人数据Recent open-weight reasoning pipelines largely fall into three recurring post-training archetypes. Parameter-efficient adaptation has also been extended to decentralized settings, where clients exchange low-rank updates without centralizing their private data(Ghiasvand et al., 2025).

(1) 快速傅里叶变换(1) SFT→\rightarrowRL 管道。RL pipelines.一个常见的方法是首先对策划的思想链（CoT）应用监督微调（SFT）A common recipe first applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated chain-of-thought (CoT)(Wei et al., 2022)演示以引发明确的多步骤推理，然后使用强化学习（RL）来优化奖励信号下的行为。奖励可能反映可验证的正确性（例如，精确匹配的数学或单元测试代码）、人类或模型偏好（例如，有用性或格式遵守）或效率目标，例如减少过度思考的简洁性。这种范式是诸如以下系统的基础demonstrations to elicit explicit multi-step reasoning, then uses reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize behavior under a reward signal. The reward may reflect verifiable correctness (e.g., exact-match math or unit-test code), human or model preferences (e.g., helpfulness or format adherence), or efficiency objectives such as conciseness to mitigate overthinking. This paradigm underlies systems such asSky-T1/闪光灯Sky-T1/Flash (NovaSky Team, 2025b; a; c), Light-R1/TinyR1 (Wen et al., 2025; Sun et al., 2025)和 Phi-4 推理变体, and Phi-4 reasoning variants(Abdin et al., 2025)，其中训练后明确权衡正确性、推理长度和风格。, where post-training explicitly trades off correctness, reasoning length, and style.

(2)基于蒸馏的管道。(2) Distillation-based pipelines.蒸馏将推理获取主要视为数据生成和过滤问题：一位强大的老师（例如，Distillation treats reasoning acquisition primarily as a data-generation and filtering problem: a strong teacher (e.g.,DeepSeek-R1 (Guo et al., 2025) or QwQ (Qwen Team, 2025a)）产生推理痕迹，然后通过标准交叉熵 SFT 将其转移给较小的学生。与 RL 相比，蒸馏通常更容易重现，训练成本也低得多，同时仍然继承了教师的推理风格和分解启发式。打开工作流程，例如) produces reasoning traces, which are then transferred to a smaller student by standard cross-entropy SFT. Compared with RL, distillation is typically easier to reproduce and much cheaper to train, while still transferring the teacher’s reasoning style and decomposition heuristics. Open workflows such as定制-StratosBespoke-Stratos (Bespoke Labs, 2025b), 开放思想/开放思想者OpenThoughts/OpenThinker (OpenThoughts Team, 2025c), 和, and开放-R1Open-R1 (Hugging Face, 2025a; Open-R1 Team, 2025e)举例说明这一行：它们缩放exemplify this line: they scale either the amount of已验证verified推理数据（来自reasoning data (from∼\sim10K 至10K to>1>1M 个例子）或严格的过滤（例如，精确匹配检查和单元测试），通常无需专门的强化学习就能获得巨大的收益。M examples) or the rigor of filtering (e.g., exact-match checks and unit tests), often achieving large gains without specialized RL.

(3)参数空间融合与合并。(3) Parameter-space fusion and merging.第三行避免基于梯度的更新，而是直接在参数空间中融合多个预训练或后训练的专家。现代合并规则，例如A third line avoids gradient-based updates and instead fuses multiple pretrained or post-trained experts directly in parameter space. Modern merging rules, such as选择-计算-擦除Select–Calculate–Erase(SCE)，计算对齐权重的结构化加权组合，以便单个合并模型继承其父模型的互补行为，例如长 CoT 数学推理和更短、更直接的响应。这种方法的基础是(SCE), compute structured weighted combinations of aligned weights so that a single merged model inherits complementary behaviors from its parents, such as long-CoT mathematical reasoning and shorter, more direct responses. This approach underlies the保险丝O1FuseO1系列和相关 FuseAI 版本family and related FuseAI releases(Wan et al., 2024a; Yang et al., 2025)，并且也出现在分支合并方案中，例如, and also appears in branch–merge schemes such as小R1TinyR1 (Sun et al., 2025)。当训练预算紧张时，融合很有吸引力，因为它可以快速执行并且不需要新数据，尽管其有效性在很大程度上取决于检查点兼容性。. Fusion is attractive when training budgets are tight because it can be performed quickly and without requiring new data, although its effectiveness depends heavily on checkpoint compatibility.

D.2 横切机制和推理控制Cross-Cutting Mechanisms and Inference Controls

同时WhileSection˜D.1描述了重复出现的管道原型，我们比较了推理系统中使用的四个横切机制类describes recurring pipeline archetypes, we compare reasoning systems along four cross-cutting mechanism classes used inFigure˜1和表and TableLABEL:tab:reasoning-models-1：经过验证的 SFT 和痕量蒸馏、RL 和偏好优化、推理时间控制和聚合以及参数空间组合。: verified SFT and trace distillation, RL and preference optimization, inference-time control and aggregation, and parameter-space composition.

CoT 蒸馏和验证的 SFT。CoT distillation and verified SFT.在低计算端，CoT 蒸馏通过标准 SFT 将解决方案分解从强大的教师转移到学生。主导因素不是原始数据量，而是At the low-compute end, CoT distillation transfers solution decompositions from a strong teacher to a student by standard SFT. The dominant factor is not raw data volume but the信息性和正确性informativeness and correctness监督，包括提供标签的注释者的可靠性of supervision, including the reliability of the annotators who provide labels(Ghiasvand et al., 2026);推理管道还在训练之前使用拒绝采样和验证，例如精确匹配数学检查或代码单元测试。这会产生紧凑但高产的语料库，可以可靠地改进强大的指令调整基础的推理; reasoning pipelines also use rejection sampling and verification, such as exact-match math checks or unit tests for code, before training. This yields compact but high-yield corpora that can reliably improve reasoning over strong instruction-tuned bases(NovaSky Team, 2025b; Bespoke Labs, 2025b; OpenThoughts Team, 2025c).

RL 和偏好优化。RL and preference optimization.当需要额外的泛化或行为控制时，强化学习式的训练后可以直接优化策略以实现正确性或符合偏好的行为。在开放权重工作中，这通常表现为数学和代码等可验证领域中基于结果的强化学习，或者表现为减少过度思考和稳定响应长度的偏好优化。直接偏好优化 (DPO)When additional generalization or behavioral control is needed, RL-style post-training can optimize policies directly for correctness or preference-aligned behavior. In open-weight work, this often appears as outcome-based RL in verifiable domains such as math and code, or as preference optimization to reduce overthinking and stabilize response length. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)(Rafailov et al., 2023)被广泛用作人类反馈强化学习 (RLHF) 的实用替代方案is widely used as a practical alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)(Ouyang et al., 2022)因为它避免了明确的奖励模型和价值函数，同时仍然优化偏好目标。在推理模型中，此类目标通常更喜欢较短的正确链而不是较长的正确链，或者惩罚冗余验证，如because it avoids an explicit reward model and value function while still optimizing a preference objective. In reasoning models, such objectives often prefer shorter correct chains over longer ones, or penalize redundant verification, as inSky-T1-闪光Sky-T1-Flash (NovaSky Team, 2025a).

推理时间缩放和聚合。Inference-time scaling and aggregation.推理准确性对推理时间计算的分配也很敏感。测试时间缩放方法对多个候选解决方案进行采样并将其聚合，例如，通过自我一致性的多数投票，以在不改变权重的情况下提高可靠性Reasoning accuracy is also sensitive to the allocation of inference-time compute. Test-time scaling methods sample multiple candidate solutions and aggregate them, for instance, by majority vote in self-consistency, to improve reliability without changing weights(Wang et al., 2022)。其他控制措施通过鼓励更长时间的审议或限制其减少延迟来分配“思考预算”，从而权衡成本和稳健性。由于这些程序修改了超出基本条件分布的有效决策规则，因此应将它们视为评估系统的一部分并明确报告。. Other controls allocate a “thinking budget” by encouraging longer deliberation or constraining it to reduce latency, thereby trading off cost and robustness. Because these procedures modify the effective decision rule beyond the base conditional distribution, they should be treated as part of the evaluated system and reported explicitly.

模型合并和融合。Model merging and fusion.最后，参数空间融合提供了一种非梯度机制，用于组合互补推理行为，例如长 CoT 能力和简洁回答。 FuseAI 风格的系统Finally, parameter-space fusion provides a non-gradient mechanism for combining complementary reasoning behaviors, such as long-CoT competence and concise answering. FuseAI-style systems(FuseAI, 2025a; b)使用异构模型融合来生成合并检查点，这些检查点通常表现得像单个混合专家，无需多阶段训练运行use heterogeneous model fusion to produce merged checkpoints that often behave like a single hybrid expert, without multi-stage training runs(Wan et al., 2024a; Yang et al., 2025)。在这种情况下，融合尤其重要，因为它可以显着改变推理长度和风格，同时保持主干族和参数计数固定。. In this setting, fusion is especially relevant because it can substantially alter reasoning length and style while keeping the backbone family and parameter count fixed.

D.3 代表性开放权重推理模型的比较Comparison of Representative Open-Weight Reasoning Models

我们对评估名册中代表的家庭或直接将其置于背景中的家庭实例化了这种分类法。表We instantiate this taxonomy on families represented in, or directly contextualizing, the evaluated roster. TableLABEL:tab:reasoning-models-1总结了本工作中检查的代表性开放权重推理模型，按机制类别、训练数据规模、基础模型以及最直接影响准确性和成本的技术选择进行组织。summarizes the representative open-weight reasoning models examined in this work, organized by mechanism class, training-data scale, base model, and the technical choices that most directly affect both accuracy and cost.

评估的模型涵盖现代推理法学硕士中使用的主要开放范式，包括经过验证的 SFT、SFT+RL/偏好优化、推理时间缩放控制和参数空间融合。这种覆盖范围对于评估很重要，因为不同的范式会导致不同的故障模式和成本概况：蒸馏和验证的 SFT 往往是稳定且可重复的；强化学习和偏好优化可以提高正确性或简洁性，但对奖励构建和验证很敏感；推理时间缩放提高了可靠性，但增加了测试时间计算；融合可以在无需额外数据的情况下大幅改变推理风格。因此，任何有意义的基准测试都必须报告模型检查点和推理协议（采样和聚合），因为即使权重固定，后者也可以改变有效的推理性能。The models evaluated span the principal open paradigms used in modern reasoning LLMs, including verified SFT, SFT+RL/preference optimization, inference-time scaling controls, and parameter-space fusion. This coverage matters for evaluation because different paradigms induce different failure modes and cost profiles: distillation and verified SFT tend to be stable and reproducible; RL and preference optimization can improve correctness or conciseness but are sensitive to reward construction and verification; inference-time scaling improves reliability but increases test-time compute; and fusion can alter reasoning style substantially without additional data. Consequently, any meaningful benchmarking must report both the model checkpoint and the inference protocol (sampling and aggregation), since the latter can change effective reasoning performance even when weights are fixed.

的TheDeepSeek-R1-蒸馏DeepSeek-R1-Distillfamily 将 R1 行为转移到标准密集主干中，而不是直接在小策略上运行 RL。发布的学生包括基于Qwen2.5的1.5B/7B/14B/32B检查点，以及基于Llama-3.1的8B检查点family transfers R1 behavior into standard dense backbones rather than running RL directly on small policies. The Hugging Face model cards report that the Qwen2.5 distilled students are fine-tuned on∼\sim800K DeepSeek-R1 精选样本，将蒸馏定位为小模型 RL 的计算稳定替代方案800K DeepSeek-R1-curated samples, positioning distillation as a compute-stable alternative to small-model RL(DeepSeek-AI, 2025a)。随附的项目文档进一步认为，从强大的老师那里提取推理模式比通过小规模的 RL 重新发现它们更有效，支持蒸馏作为开放权重设置中的标准小模型替代方案. The accompanying project documentation further argues that distilling reasoning patterns from a strong teacher is more effective than rediscovering them via RL at small scales, supporting distillation as a standard small-model alternative in open-weight settings(DeepSeek-AI, 2025b).

NovaSky（加州大学伯克利分校天空计算实验室）发布了数据配方、验证代码、训练脚本和评估工具以及权重。 Sky-T1 系列专注于两个目标：通过经过验证的小型语料库从指令调整的主干中引入可靠的长期 CoT 行为，并减少过度思考驱动的代币膨胀。NovaSky (UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab) releases data recipes, verification code, training scripts, and evaluation tooling alongside weights. The Sky-T1 line focuses on two objectives: inducing reliable long-CoT behavior from instruction-tuned backbones with small verified corpora, and reducing overthinking-driven token inflation.

Sky-T1-32B-预览版Sky-T1-32B-Preview (Li et al., 2025a)作为该系列的主打模型。李等人。表明serves as the anchor model for the series. Li et al. show thatQwen2.5-32B-指令Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct可以从 a 中获得强大的长 CoT 行为can acquire strong long-CoT behavior from a∼\sim17K 组演示，摘自17K set of demonstrations distilled fromQwQ-32B-预览版QwQ-32B-Preview通过拒绝抽样，在数学/代码基准方面取得了巨大进步，并报告了与 o1-preview 的竞争力via rejection sampling, with large gains on math/code benchmarks and reported competitiveness with o1-preview(NovaSky Team, 2025b)。该报报道称，追踪. The paper reports that trace结构structure比痕迹更重要matters more than trace内容content：扰乱表面标记比破坏步骤顺序或逻辑连贯性（例如，打乱或删除步骤）危害更小。: perturbing surface tokens is less harmful than disrupting step order or logical coherence (e.g., shuffling or deleting steps).

Sky-T1-32B-闪光灯Sky-T1-32B-Flash (NovaSky Team, 2025a)通过明确惩罚过度思考来降低部署成本。它根据每个提示的多个采样候选者形成偏好对（最短正确与最长正确），并在困难的提示上添加硬负对（短不正确与长正确）；然后，它应用长度敏感的偏好优化，并可选择重写数学解决方案，以仅保留第一个正确的解决方案和一个附加解决方案（“FCS+1”），同时保持代码输出不变。偏好阶段使用 SimPO 式目标targets deployment cost by explicitly penalizing overthinking. It forms preference pairs from multiple sampled candidates per prompt (shortest-correct vs. longest-correct) and adds hard-negative pairs (short incorrect vs. long correct) on difficult prompts; it then applies length-sensitive preference optimization and optionally rewrites math solutions to retain only the first correct solution plus one additional solution (“FCS+1”), while leaving code outputs unchanged. The preference stage uses SimPO-style objectives(Meng et al., 2024)，使推理长度控制成为直接训练目标，而不是事后解码启发式。, making reasoning-length control a direct training target rather than a post-hoc decoding heuristic.

天空-T1-7BSky-T1-7B (NovaSky Team, 2025c)通过迭代 SFT/RL 计划探索较小预算的训练后。开始于explores smaller-budget post-training with an iterative SFT/RL schedule. Starting fromQwen2.5-数学-7BQwen2.5-Math-7B，它对一组经过验证的 QwQ 蒸馏轨迹执行 SFT，通过 PRIME 风格的提示过滤应用 RL，并在 Eurus-2-RL-Data 上进行部署, it performs SFT on a small verified set of QwQ-distilled traces, applies RL with PRIME-style prompt filtering and rollouts on Eurus-2-RL-Data(Cui et al., 2025)，从另一个 SFT 阶段的中间模型中重新蒸馏，并以基于 RLOO 的 RL 阶段结束, re-distills from the intermediate model for another SFT stage, and finishes with an RLOO-based RL stage(Ahmadian et al., 2024).

D.3.5 OpenThoughts/OpenThinker：扩展经过验证的监督推理数据OpenThoughts/OpenThinker: scaling verified supervised reasoning data

开放思想OpenThoughts(Guha et al., 2025; OpenThoughts Team, 2025c)旨在通过发布用于合成跟踪生成、验证、消融和模型权重评估的管道，使训练后推理在数据配方级别上可重现。核心主张是开放权重推理收益的很大一部分可以通过以下方式实现aims to make reasoning post-training reproducible at the level of data recipes by releasing pipelines for synthetic trace generation, verification, ablations, and evaluation alongside model weights. D.3.8 NVIDIA Nemotron 推理模型NVIDIA Nemotron reasoning models

NVIDIA 的开放推理版本涵盖了与本研究相关的三个不同的操作点。NVIDIA’s open reasoning releases cover three distinct operating points relevant to this study.OpenReasoning-Nemotron-1.5B是一个紧凑的推理模型，用作数学/代码设置中的小规模开放基线，而is a compact reasoning model used as a small-scale open baseline in math/code settings, whileAceReason-Nemotron-1.1-7B通过 OpenMathReasoning 和 OpenCodeReasoning 管道更明确地关注可验证的推理focuses more explicitly on verifiable reasoning through the OpenMathReasoning and OpenCodeReasoning pipelines(Toshniwal et al., 2025; Moshkov et al., 2025; Ahmad et al., 2025a; b; Liu et al., 2025d)。它们共同标志着 NVIDIA 产品阵容的“小型密集推理机”和“可验证推理专家”两端。. Together they mark the “small dense reasoner” and “verifiable-reasoning specialist” ends of NVIDIA’s lineup.

NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 (Basant et al., 2025)添加了不同的设计点：具有可控推理行为的混合效率导向模型。相对于较小的 OpenReasoning 和 AceReason 检查点，Nano v2 在评估中非常有用，因为它测试混合架构和推理切换是否可以在减少活动计算的同时保持推理质量。因此，在我们的模型名册中，三个 Nemotron 变体为一个供应商家族内的小模型推理、可验证的训练后和以效率为导向的推理控制提供了补充证据。adds a different design point: a hybrid efficiency-oriented model with controllable reasoning behavior. Relative to the smaller OpenReasoning and AceReason checkpoints, Nano v2 is useful in evaluation because it tests whether hybrid architectures and reasoning toggles can preserve reasoning quality while reducing active compute. In our model roster, the three Nemotron variants therefore provide complementary evidence on small-model reasoning, verifiable post-training, and efficiency-oriented reasoning control within one vendor family.
