D.3.10 GAIR“少即是多”：数据最小化推理和影响感知强化学习GAIR “Less is More”: data-minimized reasoning and impact-aware RL

GAIR 的“少即是多”主张认为，训练后效率更多地由数据选择和监督结构驱动，而不是由原始数据量驱动。GAIR’s “Less is More” line argues that post-training efficiency is driven more by data selection and supervision structure than by raw volume.豪华轿车LIMO (Ye et al., 2025)用 SFT 证明了这一点demonstrates this with SFT ofQwen2.5-32B-指令Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct817 道精心策划的数学问题，配有长篇高质量 CoT 解决方案。该研究将其形式化为“少即是多”推理假设，并提出结构化演示和推理时间计算分配作为提取潜在推理能力的补充杠杆。 GAIR 随后发布on 817 curated math problems paired with long, high-quality CoT solutions. The study formalizes this as the Less-Is-More Reasoning Hypothesis and presents structured demonstrations and inference-time compute allocation as complementary levers for extracting latent reasoning capability. GAIR subsequently releasedLIMO-v2 (GAIR, 2025b)，将训练集更新为 800 个示例, updating the training set to 800 examples(GAIR, 2025a)并释放相应的and releasing a correspondingQwen2.5-32B-指令Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct微调检查点。更新后的论文将修订后的集合描述为针对每个问题选择从以下样本中抽取的最高质量的解决方案fine-tune checkpoint. The updated paper describes the revised set as selecting, for each problem, the highest-quality solution sampled fromDeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, 和, andQwQ-32B，在升级跟踪源的同时保留最小 SFT 理念, preserving the minimal-SFT philosophy while upgrading the trace sources(Ye et al., 2025).

LIMR (Li et al., 2025b)通过关注促进驱动学习的因素，将相同的效率目标转移到强化学习中。它介绍了transfers the same efficiency goal to RL by focusing on which prompts drive learning. It introduces学习影响衡量Learning Impact Measurement（LIM）通过将奖励轨迹与模型的学习动态相结合来选择高影响力的训练样本。 LIMR 报告称，选定的 1,389 个提示子集上的 RL 可以匹配或超过整个 8,523 个提示池上的 RL，这挑战了 RL 增益需要扩展提示数量的假设。该论文还强调了一种制度差异：极端 SFT 最小化在较大规模下最有效，而当选择最大化学习信号时，影响感知强化学习在较小规模下仍然有效(LIM) to select high-impact training samples by aligning reward trajectories with the model’s learning dynamics. LIMR reports that RL on a selected subset of 1,389 prompts can match or exceed RL on the full 8,523-prompt pool, challenging the assumption that RL gains require scaling prompt count. The paper also highlights a regime difference: extreme SFT minimization is most effective at larger scales, whereas impact-aware RL remains effective at smaller scales when selection maximizes learning signal(Li et al., 2025b).

D.3.11 FuseAI/FuseO1：行为组合的参数空间聚合FuseAI/FuseO1: parameter-space aggregation for behavior composition

融合和检查点合并通过直接在参数空间中组合训练有素的“专家”，提供了一种非梯度途径来组合推理行为。许多推理检查点的不同主要在于推理风格（长 CoT 与简洁的“闪现”）和领域重点；如果干扰得到控制，合并可以在一组权重中近似多专家行为，而无需额外计算，也无需新的监督数据。Fusion and checkpoint merging provide a non-gradient route to composing reasoning behaviors by combining trained “experts” directly in parameter space. Many reasoning checkpoints differ primarily in reasoning style (long-CoT vs. concise “flash”) and domain emphasis; if interference is controlled, merging can approximate multi-expert behavior in a single set of weights with negligible additional compute and no new supervision data.

保险丝人工智能FuseAI(Wan et al., 2024a; 2025; Yang et al., 2025)通过分布级和面向聊天的管道研究异构模型融合，并引入studies heterogeneous model fusion via distribution-level and chat-oriented pipelines and introduces科学教育委员会SCE（选择-计算-擦除），围绕融合向量（与主元的权重差异）和结构化的每个矩阵合并过程构建的参数矩阵合并规则。(Select–Calculate–Erase), a parameter-matrix merge rule built around fusion vectors (weight differences from a pivot) and a structured per-matrix merge procedure.保险丝O1FuseO1 (FuseAI, 2025c; a; b)应用 SCE 风格的合并来开放推理检查点，结合applies SCE-style merging to open reasoning checkpoints, combiningDeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, QwQ-32B-预览版QwQ-32B-Preview, 和, and天空-T1-32BSky-T1-32B保留长 CoT 能力的变体，同时在包含 Flash 父项时减少冗长。模型卡报告了 pass@1 和一致性风格评估下的增益，并指出合并在合并时是无数据的。在操作上，合并通常使用variants to retain long-CoT competence while reducing verbosity when a Flash parent is included. The model cards report gains under pass@1 and consistency-style evaluation and note that merging is data-free at merge time. Operationally, the merges are typically implemented using合并工具包mergekit (Arcee AI, 2024)，这使得能够快速迭代合并系数和父代选择。分支合并变体（例如 TinyR1）将在下面与 Qihoo360 模型一起讨论。, which enables rapid iteration over merge coefficients and parent selection. Branch–merge variants such as TinyR1 are discussed with the Qihoo360 models below.

D.3.12 Light-R1 和 TinyR1：课程后训练和分支合并蒸馏Light-R1 and TinyR1: curriculum post-training and branch–merge distillation

Light-R1 和 TinyR1 代表了长 CoT 推理的计算意识路线：课程式的后训练在缺乏长 CoT 的主干中诱导长 CoT 行为，以及分支合并蒸馏来组成领域专业知识。Light-R1 and TinyR1 represent compute-conscious routes to long-CoT reasoning: curriculum-style post-training to induce long-CoT behavior in backbones that lack it, and branch–merge distillation to compose domain expertise.

光-R1Light-R1 (Wen et al., 2025)目标是通过明确的分阶段管道进行长期 CoT 训练。该报告描述了一个两阶段课程 SFT，随后是半政策性 DPO，以稳定长篇推理并塑造响应风格。在“从头开始”的设定中，targets long-CoT training with an explicit staged pipeline. The report describes a two-stage curriculum SFT followed by semi-on-policy DPO to stabilize long-form reasoning and shape response style. In the “from scratch” setting,光-R1-32BLight-R1-32B (Qihoo360, 2025b)开始于starts fromQwen2.5-32B-指令Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct并接受了以数学为中心的数据的培训，报告的概括超出了数学范围，达到了更广泛的基准。该论文还强调了通过 3K“stage-2”hard long-CoT 集进行数据利用：将该集应用为额外的 SFT 可以显着提高经过 DeepSeek 精炼的学生，产生and is trained on math-focused data, with reported generalization beyond math to broader benchmarks. The paper also emphasizes data leverage via a 3K “stage-2” hard long-CoT set: applying this set as additional SFT substantially improves DeepSeek-distilled students, yielding光-R1-7B-DSLight-R1-7B-DS (Qihoo360, 2025d)和and光-R1-32B-DSLight-R1-32B-DS (Qihoo360, 2025c)来自fromDeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen检查站。最后，一旦存在长 CoT 能力，Light-R1 研究 RL：使用 GRPO，它进一步提高checkpoints. Finally, Light-R1 studies RL once long-CoT competence is present: using GRPO, it further improves光-R1-14B-DSLight-R1-14B-DS (Qihoo360, 2025a)并报告更深层次的推理和更高的奖励之间的预期耦合（通常会增加长度）。and reports the expected coupling between deeper reasoning and higher reward (often with increased length).

TinyR1-32B-预览版TinyR1-32B-Preview (Sun et al., 2025)通过分支合并蒸馏，解决了不同的杠杆：固定规模的准确性和跨域广度。它蒸馏addresses a different lever: accuracy and cross-domain breadth at fixed scale, via Branch–Merge Distillation. It distillsDeepSeek-R1使用特定领域的 SFT 划分为特定领域的分支，然后将它们合并以传输互补知识并提高超越任何单个分支的泛化能力。 TinyR1 报告持续增长into domain-specialized branches using domain-specific SFT, then merges them to transfer complementary knowledge and improve generalization beyond any single branch. TinyR1 reports consistent gains overDeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B涵盖数学/代码/科学，并评估 AIME’24 中教师的表现。across math/code/science and approaches teacher performance on AIME’24.

D.3.13 SimpleScaling s1.1 系列：用于测试时间扩展的极简 SFT 和预算强制SimpleScaling s1.1 family: minimalist SFT and budget forcing for test-time scaling

SimpleScaling 的 s1.1 系列SimpleScaling’s s1.1 family(Muennighoff et al., 2025)在小型、策划的推理集上保留了轻量级 SFT 的原始 s1 配方，并在推理时强制执行预算，同时用 DeepSeek-R1 跟踪替换了早期的 Gemini 生成的跟踪。预算强制可以通过抑制思考结束信号并附加“等待”来截断推理或扩展推理，从而使测试时计算直接可控。由此产生的配方依赖于更强大的监督和显式推理控制，而不是额外的架构或管道复杂性。preserves the original s1 recipe of lightweight SFT on a small, curated reasoning set together with budget forcing at inference time, while replacing the earlier Gemini-generated traces with DeepSeek-R1 traces. Budget forcing can either truncate reasoning or extend it by suppressing the end-of-thinking signal and appending “Wait,” making test-time compute directly controllable. The resulting recipe relies on stronger supervision and explicit inference control rather than additional architectural or pipeline complexity.

在 1.5B、3B、7B、14B 和 32B 变体中，s1.1 将相同的训练后配方应用于 Qwen2.5-Instruct 主干网，而没有针对特定规模的方法进行更改。较小的检查点主要说明跨模型大小的传输，而 s1.1-32B 充当主要参考模型。该论文通过将顺序扩展与并行聚合方法（例如多数投票和 REBASE）相结合，将预算强制置于更广泛的测试时间扩展框架内，因此 s1.1 配方仍然与采样和聚合协议而不是单个解码设置兼容。Across the 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, and 32B variants, s1.1 applies the same post-training recipe to Qwen2.5-Instruct backbones without scale-specific methodological changes. The smaller checkpoints mainly illustrate transfer across model sizes, whereas s1.1-32B serves as the primary reference model. The paper situates budget forcing within a broader test-time scaling framework by combining sequential scaling with parallel aggregation methods such as majority voting and REBASE, so the s1.1 recipe remains compatible with sampling-and-aggregation protocols rather than a single decoding setup.

D.3.14 LG EXAONE-4.0：统一的聊天推理模式和长上下文后训练LG EXAONE-4.0: unified chat-reasoning modes and long-context post-training

EXAONE-4.0 将聊天式帮助和显式推理视为单个模型系列的两种模式，而不是单独的系统。 LG 通过统一的训练后配方来实现这一点，该配方联合优化非推理和推理行为，然后是平衡正确性、简洁性和语言一致性的偏好学习阶段。重点是在 32B 和 1.2B 模型中协调可用性、深思熟虑的推理和代理行为EXAONE-4.0 treats chat-style assistance and explicit reasoning as two modes of a single model family rather than as separate systems. LG implements this with a unified post-training recipe that jointly optimizes non-reasoning and reasoning behavior, followed by preference-learning stages that balance correctness, brevity, and language consistency. The emphasis is on aligning usability, deliberate reasoning, and agentic behavior within one family across both the 32B and 1.2B models(LG AI Research, 2025).

32B 型号还采用了多种有针对性的工程选择。它没有完全依赖全局注意力，而是将滑动窗口局部注意力与全局注意力相结合，调整全局注意力路径上的位置处理以减少长上下文退化，并采用修改后的归一化方案来提高训练稳定性。其长上下文能力被视为一种训练策略，而不仅仅是一个更大的上下文窗口，其 RL 阶段引入了定制的优化方案，旨在提高推理质量，同时又不丢失 SFT 期间获得的能力。工具使用设置遵循相同的设计原则，强调与执行反馈的多轮、长视野交互，而不是孤立的工具调用。The 32B model also incorporates several targeted engineering choices. Instead of relying on fully global attention, it combines sliding-window local attention with global attention, adjusts positional handling on the global-attention path to reduce long-context degradation, and adopts a revised normalization scheme to improve training stability. Its long-context capability is framed as a training strategy rather than only a larger context window, and its RL stage introduces a customized optimization scheme aimed at improving reasoning quality without losing capabilities acquired during SFT. The tool-use setup follows the same design principle, emphasizing multi-turn, long-horizon interaction with execution feedback rather than isolated tool calls.

响应记录包括全文、宽度 20 令牌替代项、 基于规则的多项选择结果、CompassVerifier-3B 和逐点 Qwen 记录。指南针仍然具有参考辅助功能；点式 Qwen 依然存在 免参考。由于采样单元是固定的 50 项字段切片，因此任意 总数应按现场平衡而非自然数报告 SuperGPQA 微平均。The response records include full text, width-20 token alternatives, the rule-based multiple-choice result, CompassVerifier-3B, and the pointwise Qwen record. Compass remains reference-assisted; pointwise Qwen remains reference-free. Because the sampling unit is a fixed 50-item field slice, any overall number should be reported as field-balanced rather than as a natural SuperGPQA micro-average.

记录图层。Record layers.

Table˜15总结了共同领域和意图 块之间的差异。即使在以下情况下，该版本也会保留原始响应文本： 答案提取器失败。信号丰富的数学中精确重复的候选者 块共享验证器计算，但每个原始存档位置都保留 它自己的结果有效负载的副本。summarizes the common fields and the intentional differences between blocks. The release preserves raw response text even when an answer extractor fails. Exact duplicate candidates in the signal-rich math block share verifier computations, but every original archive location keeps its own copy of the resulting payload.

rich-capture 环境总结为The rich-capture environment is summarized inTable˜16。的 广泛且重复的数学档案不包含硬件清单，因此 我们不会猜测他们的加速器类型或 GPU 数量。. The broad and repeated-mathematics archives do not contain a hardware manifest, so we do not guess their accelerator type or GPU count.

分析拒绝丢失记录、重复身份、非有限需求 值、超出范围的分数和意外的网格。他们阅读源档案 而不修改它们。发布级清单验证完整文件模式， 令牌数组宽度、压缩完整性和文件哈希。The analyses reject missing records, duplicate identities, nonfinite required values, out-of-range scores, and unexpected grids. They read source archives without modifying them. Release-level manifests validate full-file schemas, token-array widths, compression integrity, and file hashes.

许可和使用。Licensing and use.

在审核的快照中，数据集卡声明 MMLU-Pro 的 MIT 和 AIME’24、AIME’25 的 Apache-2.0、引用的 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 MathArena 托管集和 SuperGPQA 的 ODC-BYAt the audited snapshots, the dataset cards declare MIT for MMLU-Pro and AIME’24, Apache-2.0 for AIME’25, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the cited MathArena-hosted sets, and ODC-BY for SuperGPQA(TIGER-Lab, 2024; Jia, 2024; math-ai, 2025; MathArena, 2025c; a; 2026a; 2026b; d; b; e; M-A-P Team, 2025)。使用的BBH镜 harness 未在其数据集卡上声明许可证. The BBH mirror used by the harness does not declare a license on its dataset card(SaylorTwift, 2025)。 数据集卡元数据本身并不决定生成的术语 模型输出或底层组件问题。因此发布 保留来源归属和模型标识符，并且用户保留 负责适用于每个组件的条款。. Dataset-card metadata does not by itself determine the terms of generated model outputs or underlying component questions. The release therefore preserves source attribution and model identifiers, and users remain responsible for the terms applicable to each component.
